Shoal Cave Low Tide Lower Room
Shoal Cave Low Tide Inner Room
Shoal Cave Low Tide Entrance Room

SPECIES_DRATINI.name: Dratini
SPECIES_DRATINI.description: A Dratini continually molts and sloughs off its old skin. It does so because the life energy within its body steadily builds to reach uncontrollable levels.

SPECIES_DRAGONAIR.name: Dragonair
SPECIES_DRAGONAIR.description: A Dragonair stores an enormous amount of energy inside its body. It is said to alter the weather around it by loosing energy from the crystals on its neck and tail.

SPECIES_DRAGONITE.name: Dragonite
SPECIES_DRAGONITE.description: It can circle the globe in just 16 hours. It is a kindhearted Pokémon that leads lost and foundering ships in a storm to the safety of land.

SPECIES_MEWTWO.name: Mewtwo
SPECIES_MEWTWO.description: A Pokémon that was created by genetic manipulation. However, even though the scientific power of humans made its body, they failed to give it a warm heart.

SPECIES_MEWTWO_MEGA_X.name: Mewtwo
SPECIES_MEWTWO_MEGA_X.description: Psychic power has augmented its muscles. It has a grip strength of one ton and can sprint a hundred meters in two seconds flat!

SPECIES_MEWTWO_MEGA_Y.name: Mewtwo
SPECIES_MEWTWO_MEGA_Y.description: Despite its diminished size, its mental power has grown phenomenally. With a mere thought, it can smash a skyscraper to smithereens.

SPECIES_MEW.name: Mew
SPECIES_MEW.description: A Mew is said to possess the genes of all Pokémon. It is capable of making itself invisible at will, so it entirely avoids notice even if it approaches people.

SPECIES_CHIKORITA.name: Chikorita
SPECIES_CHIKORITA.description: It waves its leaf around to keep foes at bay. However, a sweet fragrance also wafts from the leaf, creating a friendly atmosphere that becalms the battlers.

SPECIES_BAYLEEF.name: Bayleef
SPECIES_BAYLEEF.description: A Bayleef's neck is ringed by curled-up leaves. Inside each leaf is a small tree shoot. The fragrance of this shoot makes people peppy.

SPECIES_MEGANIUM.name: Meganium
SPECIES_MEGANIUM.description: The fragrance of a Meganium's flower soothes and calms emotions. In battle, it gives off more of its becalming scent to blunt the foe's fighting spirit.

SPECIES_CYNDAQUIL.name: Cyndaquil
SPECIES_CYNDAQUIL.description: It flares flames from its back to protect itself. The fire burns vigorously if the Pokémon is angry. When it is tired, it sputters with incomplete combustion.

SPECIES_QUILAVA.name: Quilava
SPECIES_QUILAVA.description: It intimidates foes with intense gusts of flames and superheated air. Its quick nimbleness lets it dodge attacks even while scorching an enemy.

SPECIES_TYPHLOSION.name: Typhlosion
SPECIES_TYPHLOSION.description: It can hide behind a shimmering heat haze that it creates using its intense flames. Typhlosion create blazing explosive blasts that burn everything to cinders.

SPECIES_TYPHLOSION_HISUI.name: Typhlosion
SPECIES_TYPHLOSION_HISUI.description: Said to purify lost, forsaken souls with its flames and guide them to the afterlife. It's believed its form was influenced by the energy of Mt. Coronet in ancient times.

SPECIES_TOTODILE.name: Totodile
SPECIES_TOTODILE.description: Despite its small body, Totodile's jaws are very powerful. While it may think it is just playfully nipping, its bite has enough strength to cause serious injury.

SPECIES_CROCONAW.name: Croconaw
SPECIES_CROCONAW.description: Once its jaws clamp down on its foe, it will absolutely not let go. Because the tips of its fangs are forked back like fishhooks, they become irremovably embedded.

SPECIES_FERALIGATR.name: Feraligatr
SPECIES_FERALIGATR.description: It opens its huge mouth to intimidate enemies. In battle, it runs using its thick and powerful hind legs to charge the foe with incredible speed.

SPECIES_TOTODILE_LOGI.name: Totodile
SPECIES_TOTODILE_LOGI.description: Its wings are still developing, so its time spent floating in the air is limited. Totodile loves to make friends all across the world.

SPECIES_CROCONAW_LOGI.name: Croconaw
SPECIES_CROCONAW_LOGI.description: Its overjoyed about being able to finally fly and meet all kinds of different friends. However, its big jaw means it needs to work harder at befriending some.

SPECIES_FERALIGATR_LOGI.name: Feraligatr
SPECIES_FERALIGATR_LOGI.description: It opens its huge mouth to intimidate anybody who would threaten its friends. Seeing it carrying multiple others across the sky at great speed is common.

SPECIES_SENTRET.name: Sentret
SPECIES_SENTRET.description: They take turns standing guard when it is time to sleep. The sentry awakens the others if it senses danger. If one becomes separated, it turns sleepless with fear.

SPECIES_FURRET.name: Furret
SPECIES_FURRET.description: A Furret has a very slim build. When under attack, it can squirm through narrow spaces and get away. In spite of its short limbs, it is very nimble and fleet.

SPECIES_SENTRET_LOGI.name: Sentret
SPECIES_SENTRET_LOGI.description: Though unassuming in stature, it has a great hidden potential inside it waiting to be unleashed if it feels endangered.

SPECIES_FURRET_LOGI.name: Furret
SPECIES_FURRET_LOGI.description: Its evolution was greatly surprising. Nobody knows where its whimsical power comes from. Luckily, most Furret are perfectly content to play and explore.

SPECIES_HOOTHOOT.name: Hoothoot
SPECIES_HOOTHOOT.description: It has an internal organ that senses the earth's rotation. Using this special organ, a Hoothoot begins hooting at precisely the same time every day.

SPECIES_NOCTOWL.name: Noctowl
SPECIES_NOCTOWL.description: It unfailingly catches prey in darkness. Noctowl owe their success to superior vision that allows them to see in minimal light, and to their supple and silent wings.

SPECIES_LEDYBA.name: Ledyba
SPECIES_LEDYBA.description: Ledyba communicate using a fluid that they secrete from where the legs join the body. They are said to convey feelings to others by altering the fluid's scent.

SPECIES_LEDIAN.name: Ledian
SPECIES_LEDIAN.description: It is said that in lands with clean air, where the stars fill the sky, there live many Ledian. For good reason, they use the light of the stars as energy.

SPECIES_SPINARAK.name: Spinarak
SPECIES_SPINARAK.description: The web it spins can be considered its second nervous system. It is said that a Spinarak determines its prey by the tiny vibrations it feels through the web.

SPECIES_ARIADOS.name: Ariados
SPECIES_ARIADOS.description: Its feet are tipped with tiny hooked claws that enable it to scuttle on ceilings and vertical walls. It constricts its foe with thin and strong silk webbing.

SPECIES_CHINCHOU.name: Chinchou
SPECIES_CHINCHOU.description: When it senses danger, it discharges positive and negative electricity from its two antennae. It lives in depths beyond sunlight's reach.

SPECIES_LANTURN.name: Lanturn
SPECIES_LANTURN.description: The light-emitting orbs on its back are very bright. They are formed from a part of its dorsal fin. This Pokémon illuminates the inky darkness of deep seas.

SPECIES_TOGEPI.name: Togepi
SPECIES_TOGEPI.description: As its energy, it uses the feelings of compassion and pleasure exuded by people and Pokémon. It stores up happy feelings in its shell, then shares them out.

SPECIES_TOGETIC.name: Togetic
SPECIES_TOGETIC.description: It is said to be a Pokémon that brings good fortune. When it spots someone who is pure of heart, a Togetic appears and shares its happiness with that person.

SPECIES_TOGEKISS.name: Togekiss
SPECIES_TOGEKISS.description: As everyone knows, it visits peaceful regions, bringing them gifts of kindness and sweet blessings. It will never appear where there is strife.

SPECIES_NATU.name: Natu
SPECIES_NATU.description: It runs up short trees that grow on the savanna to peck at new shoots. A Natu's eyes look as if they are always observing something.

SPECIES_XATU.name: Xatu
SPECIES_XATU.description: It has the enigmatic power of foreseeing the future. Some people in different lands have long believed that Xatu are emissaries from another world.

SPECIES_MAREEP.name: Mareep
SPECIES_MAREEP.description: Its fluffy wool rubs together and builds a static charge. The more energy is charged, the more brightly the lightbulb at the tip of its tail glows.

SPECIES_FLAAFFY.name: Flaaffy
SPECIES_FLAAFFY.description: Its fleece quality changes to generate strong static electricity with a small amount of wool. The bare, slick parts of its hide are shielded against electricity.

SPECIES_AMPHAROS.name: Ampharos
SPECIES_AMPHAROS.description: It gives off so much light that it can be seen even from space. People in the old days used its light to send signals back and forth with others far away.

SPECIES_AMPHAROS_MEGA.name: Ampharos
SPECIES_AMPHAROS_MEGA.description: Massive amounts of energy intensely stimulated Ampharos's cells, apparently awakening its long-sleeping dragon's blood.

SPECIES_AZURILL.name: Azurill
SPECIES_AZURILL.description: Its tail, which is packed with nutrition, is very bouncy like a rubber ball. On sunny days they gather at the edge of water and splash about for fun.

SPECIES_MARILL.name: Marill
SPECIES_MARILL.description: Its body is covered with water-repellent fur. Because of the fur, it can swim through water at high speed without being slowed by the water's resistance.

SPECIES_AZUMARILL.name: Azumarill
SPECIES_AZUMARILL.description: It lives in water virtually all day long. Its body color and pattern act as camouflage that makes it tough for enemies to spot in water.

SPECIES_BONSLY.name: Bonsly
SPECIES_BONSLY.description: Bonsly prefers an arid atmosphere. In order to adjust the level of fluids in its body, it exudes water from its eyes. This makes it appear to be crying.

SPECIES_SUDOWOODO.name: Sudowoodo
SPECIES_SUDOWOODO.description: It mimics a tree to avoid being attacked by enemies. But since its forelegs remain green throughout the year, it is easily identified as a fake in the winter.

SPECIES_HOPPIP.name: Hoppip
SPECIES_HOPPIP.description: This Pokémon drifts and floats with the wind. If it senses the approach of strong winds, a Hoppip links leaves with others to prepare against being blown away.

SPECIES_SKIPLOOM.name: Skiploom
SPECIES_SKIPLOOM.description: It blossoms when the temperature rises above 64 degrees F. Because its flower's blooming changes with the temperature, it is sometimes used as a thermometer.

SPECIES_JUMPLUFF.name: Jumpluff
SPECIES_JUMPLUFF.description: Jumpluff ride warm southern winds to cross the sea and fly to foreign lands. This Pokémon lands when it encounters cold air while it is floating.

SPECIES_AIPOM.name: Aipom
SPECIES_AIPOM.description: Its tail ends with a dexterous, handlike appendage. However, because it uses the tail so much, Aipom's real hands have become rather clumsy.

SPECIES_AMBIPOM.name: Ambipom
SPECIES_AMBIPOM.description: They live on large trees. Split into two, the tails are so adept at handling and doing things, Ambipom rarely uses its hands now.

SPECIES_SUNKERN.name: Sunkern
SPECIES_SUNKERN.description: Sunkern try to minimize movement to conserve the nutrients they have stored in their bodies for evolution. They will not eat, subsisting only on morning dew.

SPECIES_SUNFLORA.name: Sunflora
SPECIES_SUNFLORA.description: Sunflora convert solar energy into nutrition. They are highly active in the warm daytime but suddenly stop moving as soon as the sun sets.

SPECIES_YANMA.name: Yanma
SPECIES_YANMA.description: It can see 360 degrees without moving its eyes. It is a great flier capable of making sudden stops and turning midair to quickly chase down targeted prey.

SPECIES_YANMEGA.name: Yanmega
SPECIES_YANMEGA.description: This six-legged Pokémon is easily capable of transporting an adult in flight. It is adept at biting apart foes while flying by at high speed.

SPECIES_WOOPER.name: Wooper
SPECIES_WOOPER.description: Wooper usually live in water but come out onto land seeking food occasionally. On land, they coat their bodies with a gooey, toxic film.

SPECIES_QUAGSIRE.name: Quagsire
SPECIES_QUAGSIRE.description: A Quagsire hunts by leaving its mouth wide open in water and waiting for its prey to blunder in. Because it doesn't move, it does not get very hungry.

SPECIES_WOOPER_PALDEA.name: Wooper
SPECIES_WOOPER_PALDEA.description: After losing a territorial struggle, Wooper began living on land. The Pokémon changed over time, developing a poisonous film to protect its body.

SPECIES_CLODSIRE.name: Clodsire
SPECIES_CLODSIRE.description: When attacked, this Pokémon will retaliate by sticking thick spines out from its body. It's a risky move that puts everything on the line.

SPECIES_MURKROW.name: Murkrow
SPECIES_MURKROW.description: Murkrow were feared as the alleged bearers of ill fortune. It shows strong interest in anything that sparkles. It will even try to steal rings from women.

SPECIES_HONCHKROW.name: Honchkrow
SPECIES_HONCHKROW.description: Becoming active at night, it is known to swarm with numerous Murkrow in tow. It is said that it never forgives the mistakes of its cronies.

SPECIES_MISDREAVUS.name: Misdreavus
SPECIES_MISDREAVUS.description: A Misdreavus frightens people with a creepy, sobbing cry. It apparently uses its red spheres to absorb the fear of foes as its nutrition.

SPECIES_MISMAGIUS.name: Mismagius
SPECIES_MISMAGIUS.description: Its cries sound like incantations. Those hearing it are tormented by headaches and hallucinations. It appears where you least expect it.

SPECIES_WYNAUT.name: Wynaut
SPECIES_WYNAUT.description: A Wynaut loves to eat sweet fruits. It cleverly picks fruits using its earlike arms. They gather in fruit gardens, drawn by the fragrance.

SPECIES_WOBBUFFET.name: Wobbuffet
SPECIES_WOBBUFFET.description: Usually docile, a Wobbuffet strikes back ferociously if its black tail is attacked. It makes its lair in caves where it waits for nightfall.

SPECIES_GIRAFARIG.name: Girafarig
SPECIES_GIRAFARIG.description: A Girafarig is an herbivore--it eats grass and tree shoots. While it is eating, its tail makes chewing and swallowing motions as if it were also eating.

SPECIES_FARIGIRAF.name: Farigiraf
SPECIES_FARIGIRAF.description: Now that the brain waves from the head and tail are synced up, the psychic power of this Pokémon is 10 times stronger than Girafarig's.

SPECIES_PINECO.name: Pineco
SPECIES_PINECO.description: A Pineco hangs from a tree branch and waits for prey. While eating, if it is disturbed by someone shaking its tree, it falls on the ground and suddenly explodes.

SPECIES_FORRETRESS.name: Forretress
SPECIES_FORRETRESS.description: It keeps itself inside its steel shell. The shell is opened when it is catching prey, but it is so quick that the shell's inside cannot be seen.

SPECIES_DUNSPARCE.name: Dunsparce
SPECIES_DUNSPARCE.description: Its drill-tipped tail is used to burrow into the ground backwards. This Pokémon is known to make its nest in complex shapes deep under the ground.

SPECIES_DUDUNSPARCE_TWO_SEGMENT.name: Dudunsparce
SPECIES_DUDUNSPARCE_TWO_SEGMENT.description: This Pokémon uses its hard tail to make its nest by boring holes into bedrock deep underground. The nest can reach lengths of over six miles.

SPECIES_DUDUNSPARCE_THREE_SEGMENT.name: Dudunsparce
SPECIES_DUDUNSPARCE_THREE_SEGMENT.description: A recent study uncovered that the number of segments a Dudunsparce's body has is determined by the Pokémon's genes.

SPECIES_GLIGAR.name: Gligar
SPECIES_GLIGAR.description: It glides without making a single sound. It grasps the face of its foe using its hind and large front claws, then stabs with its poison barb.

SPECIES_GLISCOR.name: Gliscor
SPECIES_GLISCOR.description: Gliscor observes prey while hanging upside down from branches. Its flight is soundless. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!

SPECIES_SNUBBULL.name: Snubbull
SPECIES_SNUBBULL.description: By baring its fangs and making a scary face, it sends smaller Pokémon scurrying in terror. The Snubbull does seem a little sad at making its foes flee.

SPECIES_GRANBULL.name: Granbull
SPECIES_GRANBULL.description: It has a particularly well-developed lower jaw. The huge fangs are heavy, causing it to tilt its head. Unless it is startled, it will not try to bite.

SPECIES_QWILFISH.name: Qwilfish
SPECIES_QWILFISH.description: A Qwilfish uses the pressure of water it swallows to shoot toxic quills all at once from all over its body. It finds swimming to be somewhat challenging.

SPECIES_QWILFISH_HISUI.name: Qwilfish
SPECIES_QWILFISH_HISUI.description: A form of Qwilfish from the distant past. Fishers detest this troublesome Pokémon because it sprays poison from its spines, getting it everywhere.

SPECIES_OVERQWIL.name: Overqwil
SPECIES_OVERQWIL.description: Its lancelike spikes and savage temperament have earned it the nickname “Sea Fiend”. It slurps up poison to nourish itself.

SPECIES_SHUCKLE.name: Shuckle
SPECIES_SHUCKLE.description: A Shuckle hides under rocks, keeping its body concealed inside its shell while eating stored berries. The berries mix with its body fluids to become a juice.

SPECIES_HERACROSS.name: Heracross
SPECIES_HERACROSS.description: They gather in forests seeking the sweet sap of trees. It is completely clad in a steel-hard shell. It is proud of its horn, which it uses to fling foes.

SPECIES_HERACROSS_MEGA.name: Heracross
SPECIES_HERACROSS_MEGA.description: A tremendous influx of energy builds it up, but when Mega Evolution ends, Heracross is bothered by terrible soreness in its muscles.

SPECIES_SNEASEL.name: Sneasel
SPECIES_SNEASEL.description: A Sneasel scales trees by punching its hooked claws into the bark. It seeks out unguarded nests and steals eggs for food while the parents are away.

SPECIES_WEAVILE.name: Weavile
SPECIES_WEAVILE.description: They travel in groups of four or five, leaving signs for one another on trees and rocks. They bring down their prey with coordinated attacks.

SPECIES_SNEASEL_HISUI.name: Sneasel
SPECIES_SNEASEL_HISUI.description: Its sturdy, curved claws are ideal for traversing precipitous cliffs. From the tips of these claws drips a venom that infiltrates the nerves of any prey caught.

SPECIES_SNEASLER.name: Sneasler
SPECIES_SNEASLER.description: Because of its wicked poison and daunting physical prowess, no other species could hope to best it on frozen highlands. It prefers solitude and doesn't form packs.

SPECIES_TEDDIURSA.name: Teddiursa
SPECIES_TEDDIURSA.description: It licks its palms that are sweetened by being soaked in honey. A Teddiursa makes its own honey by blending fruits and pollen collected by Beedrill.

SPECIES_URSARING.name: Ursaring
SPECIES_URSARING.description: In forests, it is said that there are many streams and towering trees where an Ursaring gathers food. It walks through its forest collecting food every day.

SPECIES_URSALUNA.name: Ursaluna
SPECIES_URSALUNA.description: Swampy terrain gives Ursaluna its burly physique and newfound capacity to manipulate peat at will.

SPECIES_URSALUNA_BLOODMOON.name: Ursaluna
SPECIES_URSALUNA_BLOODMOON.description: It crossed the sea and drifted ashore in a new land. Surviving in this place led it to take on a unique appearance and gain special powers.

SPECIES_SLUGMA.name: Slugma
SPECIES_SLUGMA.description: It is a species of Pokémon that lives in volcanic areas. If its body cools, its skin hardens and immobilizes it. To avoid that, it sleeps near magma.

SPECIES_MAGCARGO.name: Magcargo
SPECIES_MAGCARGO.description: The shell on its back is made of hardened magma. Tens of thousands of years spent living in volcanic craters have turned Magcargo's bodies into magma.

SPECIES_SWINUB.name: Swinub
SPECIES_SWINUB.description: It roots for food by rubbing its snout against the ground. Its favorite food is a mushroom that grows under dried grass. It occasionally roots out hot springs.

locations.map: Shoal Cave Low Tide Ice Room

SPECIES_PILOSWINE.name: Piloswine
SPECIES_PILOSWINE.description: A Piloswine is covered by a thick coat of long hair for enduring freezing cold. It uses its tusks to dig up food that has been buried under ice.

SPECIES_MAMOSWINE.name: Mamoswine
SPECIES_MAMOSWINE.description: A frozen Mamoswine was dug from ice dating back 10,000 years. It woke up to much amazement. This Pokémon has been around for a long, long, long time.

SPECIES_CORSOLA.name: Corsola
SPECIES_CORSOLA.description: Corsola live in warm southern seas. If the sea becomes polluted, the beautiful coral stalks become discolored and crumble away in tatters.

SPECIES_CORSOLA_GALAR.name: Corsola
SPECIES_CORSOLA_GALAR.description: Sudden climate change wiped out this ancient kind of Corsola. With its branches, it absorbs others' life-force. It curses those unaware that kick it by accident.

SPECIES_CURSOLA.name: Cursola
SPECIES_CURSOLA.description: Its shell is overflowing with its heightened otherworldly energy. The ectoplasm serves as protection for this Pokémon's core spirit.

SPECIES_REMORAID.name: Remoraid
SPECIES_REMORAID.description: A Remoraid uses its abdominal muscles to forcefully expel swallowed water, then shoot down flying prey. When evolution approaches, it travels down rivers.

SPECIES_OCTILLERY.name: Octillery
SPECIES_OCTILLERY.description: It ensnares its foe with its suction- cupped tentacles before delivering the finishing blow. If the foe turns out to be too strong, it spews ink to escape.

SPECIES_DELIBIRD.name: Delibird
SPECIES_DELIBIRD.description: It carries food bundled up in its tail. There was a famous explorer who managed to scale Mt. Everest thanks to a Delibird sharing its food.

locations.map: Shoal Cave Low Tide Ice Room

SPECIES_MANTYKE.name: Mantyke
SPECIES_MANTYKE.description: When it swims close to the surface of the ocean, people aboard ships are able to observe the pattern on its back. It often swims in a school of Remoraid.

SPECIES_MANTINE.name: Mantine
SPECIES_MANTINE.description: On sunny days, schools of Mantine can be seen elegantly leaping over the waves. It is not bothered by the Remoraid that hitches rides.

SPECIES_SKARMORY.name: Skarmory
SPECIES_SKARMORY.description: A Pokémon that has a body and wings of steel. People in the past used feathers fallen from Skarmory to make swords and knives.

SPECIES_HOUNDOUR.name: Houndour
SPECIES_HOUNDOUR.description: Houndour communicate with each other using a variety of cries to corner their prey. This Pokémon's remarkable teamwork is simply unparalleled.

SPECIES_HOUNDOOM.name: Houndoom
SPECIES_HOUNDOOM.description: In a Houndoom pack, the one with its horns raked sharply back serves a leadership role. They choose their leader by fighting among themselves.

SPECIES_HOUNDOOM_MEGA.name: Houndoom
SPECIES_HOUNDOOM_MEGA.description: Its red claws and the tips of its tail are melting from high internal temperatures that are painful to Houndoom itself.

SPECIES_PHANPY.name: Phanpy
SPECIES_PHANPY.description: Phanpy's big ears serve as broad fans. When it becomes hot, it flaps the ears busily to cool down. Even the young are very strong.

SPECIES_DONPHAN.name: Donphan
SPECIES_DONPHAN.description: A Donphan is so strong it can easily haul a dump truck. Its hide has toughened to a rock-hard state. An ordinary sort of attack won't even leave a scratch.

SPECIES_STANTLER.name: Stantler
SPECIES_STANTLER.description: Stantler's magnificent antlers were once traded at high prices as works of art. As a result, this Pokémon was hunted close to extinction.

SPECIES_WYRDEER.name: Wyrdeer
SPECIES_WYRDEER.description: The black orbs shine with an uncanny light when it is erecting invisible barriers. The fur shed from its beard retains heat and is useful for winter clothing.

SPECIES_SMEARGLE.name: Smeargle
SPECIES_SMEARGLE.description: A Smeargle marks its territory using a fluid that leaks out from the tip of its tail. About 5,000 different marks left by this Pokémon have been found.

SPECIES_MILTANK.name: Miltank
SPECIES_MILTANK.description: It gives over five gallons of milk daily. Its sweet milk is enjoyed by children and grown-ups alike. People who can't drink milk turn it into yogurt and eat it instead.

SPECIES_RAIKOU.name: Raikou
SPECIES_RAIKOU.description: Raikou embodies the speed of lightning. Its roars send shock waves shuddering through the air and ground as if lightning bolts were crashing down.

SPECIES_ENTEI.name: Entei
SPECIES_ENTEI.description: Entei embodies the passion of magma. It is thought to have been born in the eruption of a volcano. It blasts fire that consumes all that it touches.

SPECIES_SUICUNE.name: Suicune
SPECIES_SUICUNE.description: Suicune embodies the compassion of a pure spring of water. It runs across the land with gliding elegance. It has the power to purify dirty water.

SPECIES_LARVITAR.name: Larvitar
SPECIES_LARVITAR.description: A Larvitar is born deep under the ground. It must eat its way through the soil above and reach the surface for it to see its parents' faces.

SPECIES_PUPITAR.name: Pupitar
SPECIES_PUPITAR.description: A Pupitar creates a gas inside its body that it ejects under compression to propel itself like a jet. Its body can withstand a collision with solid steel.

SPECIES_TYRANITAR.name: Tyranitar
SPECIES_TYRANITAR.description: A Tyranitar is so overwhelmingly powerful, it can bring down a whole mountain to make its nest. It roams in mountains seeking new opponents to fight.

SPECIES_TYRANITAR_MEGA.name: Tyranitar
SPECIES_TYRANITAR_MEGA.description: Due to the colossal power poured into it, this Pokémon's back split right open. Its destructive instincts are the only thing keeping it moving.

SPECIES_LUGIA.name: Lugia
SPECIES_LUGIA.description: Lugia is so powerful even a light fluttering of its wings can blow apart houses. As a result, it chooses to live out of sight deep under the sea.

SPECIES_HO_OH.name: Ho-Oh
SPECIES_HO_OH.description: Its feathers--which glow in seven colors depending on the angle at which they are struck by light--are thought to bring joy. It is said to live at the foot of a rainbow.

SPECIES_CELEBI.name: Celebi
SPECIES_CELEBI.description: This Pokémon came from the future by crossing over time. It is thought that so long as Celebi appears, a bright and shining future awaits us.

SPECIES_TREECKO.name: Treecko
SPECIES_TREECKO.description: It makes its nest in a giant tree in the forest. It ferociously guards against anything nearing its territory. It is said to be the protector of the forest's trees.

SPECIES_GROVYLE.name: Grovyle
SPECIES_GROVYLE.description: Leaves grow out of this Pokémon's body. They help obscure a Grovyle from the eyes of its enemies while it is in a thickly overgrown forest.

SPECIES_SCEPTILE.name: Sceptile
SPECIES_SCEPTILE.description: In the jungle, its power is without equal. This Pokémon carefully grows trees and plants. It regulates its body temperature by basking in sunlight.

SPECIES_SCEPTILE_MEGA.name: Sceptile
SPECIES_SCEPTILE_MEGA.description: Thanks to the power in its quick legs, Mega Sceptile can be on its opponent in a flash. It can cut off a portion of its tail to fire it like a missile at an opponent.

SPECIES_TORCHIC.name: Torchic
SPECIES_TORCHIC.description: If attacked, it strikes back by spitting balls of fire it forms in its stomach. A Torchic dislikes darkness because it can't see its surroundings.

SPECIES_COMBUSKEN.name: Combusken
SPECIES_COMBUSKEN.description: It lashes out with 10 kicks per second. Its strong fighting instinct compels it to keep up its offensive until the opponent gives up.

SPECIES_BLAZIKEN.name: Blaziken
SPECIES_BLAZIKEN.description: It learns martial arts that use punches and kicks. Every several years, its old feathers burn off, and new, supple feathers grow back in their place.

SPECIES_BLAZIKEN_MEGA.name: Blaziken
SPECIES_BLAZIKEN_MEGA.description: As it unleashes a flurry of savage kicks, its legs can begin to burn from the friction of the surrounding atmosphere. They're always a source of pride to it.

SPECIES_MUDKIP.name: Mudkip
SPECIES_MUDKIP.description: On land, it can powerfully lift large boulders by planting its four feet and heaving. It sleeps by burying itself in soil at the water's edge.

SPECIES_MARSHTOMP.name: Marshtomp
SPECIES_MARSHTOMP.description: Its toughened hind legs enable it to stand upright. Because it weakens if its skin dries out, it replenishes fluids by playing in mud.

SPECIES_SWAMPERT.name: Swampert
SPECIES_SWAMPERT.description: If it senses the approach of a storm and a tidal wave, it protects its seaside nest by piling up boulders. It swims as fast as a jet ski.

SPECIES_SWAMPERT_MEGA.name: Swampert
SPECIES_SWAMPERT_MEGA.description: When it Mega Evolves, the strength that it needs to act in the water is increased. It can use its tenacious power both on land and in the water.

SPECIES_POOCHYENA.name: Poochyena
SPECIES_POOCHYENA.description: It savagely threatens foes with bared fangs. It chases after fleeing targets tenaciously. It turns tail and runs, however, if the foe strikes back.

SPECIES_MIGHTYENA.name: Mightyena
SPECIES_MIGHTYENA.description: In the wild, Mightyena live in a pack. They never defy their leader's orders. They defeat foes with perfectly coordinated teamwork.

SPECIES_ZIGZAGOON.name: Zigzagoon
SPECIES_ZIGZAGOON.description: Rubbing its nose against the ground, it always wanders about back and forth in search of something. It is distinguished by the zigzag footprints it leaves.

SPECIES_LINOONE.name: Linoone
SPECIES_LINOONE.description: It is exceedingly fast if it only has to run in a straight line. When it spots pond- dwelling prey underwater, it quickly leaps in and catches it with its sharp claws.

SPECIES_ZIGZAGOON_GALAR.name: Zigzagoon
SPECIES_ZIGZAGOON_GALAR.description: Its restlessness has it constantly moving in zigzags. It will purposely run into other Pokémon to start fights. It's thought to be the oldest form of Zigzagoon.

SPECIES_LINOONE_GALAR.name: Linoone
SPECIES_LINOONE_GALAR.description: This very aggressive Pokémon will recklessly challenge opponents stronger than itself. It uses its long tongue to taunt them to then tackle forcefully.

SPECIES_OBSTAGOON.name: Obstagoon
SPECIES_OBSTAGOON.description: Its voice is staggering in volume. Obstagoon has a tendency to take on a threatening posture and shout--this move is known as Obstruct.

SPECIES_WURMPLE.name: Wurmple
SPECIES_WURMPLE.description: It sticks to tree branches and eats leaves. The thread it spits from its mouth, which becomes gooey when it touches air, slows the movement of its foes.

SPECIES_SILCOON.name: Silcoon
SPECIES_SILCOON.description: It prepares for evolution using the energy it stored while it was a Wurmple. It keeps watch over the surroundings with its two eyes.

SPECIES_BEAUTIFLY.name: Beautifly
SPECIES_BEAUTIFLY.description: Its colorfully patterned wings are its most prominent feature. It flies through flower-covered fields collecting pollen. It attacks ferociously when angered.

SPECIES_CASCOON.name: Cascoon
SPECIES_CASCOON.description: To avoid detection by its enemies, it hides motionlessly beneath large leaves and in the gaps of branches. It also attaches dead leaves to its body for camouflage.

SPECIES_DUSTOX.name: Dustox
SPECIES_DUSTOX.description: It is a nocturnal Pokémon that flies from fields and mountains to the attraction of streetlights at night. It looses highly toxic powder from its wings.

SPECIES_LOTAD.name: Lotad
SPECIES_LOTAD.description: This Pokémon lives in ponds with clean water. It is known to ferry small Pokémon across ponds by carrying them on the broad leaf on its head.

SPECIES_LOMBRE.name: Lombre
SPECIES_LOMBRE.description: In the evening, it takes great delight in popping out of rivers and startling people. It feeds on aquatic moss that grows on rocks in the riverbed.

SPECIES_LUDICOLO.name: Ludicolo
SPECIES_LUDICOLO.description: When it hears festive music, all the cells in its body become stimulated, and it begins moving in rhythm. It does not quail even when it faces a tough opponent.

SPECIES_SEEDOT.name: Seedot
SPECIES_SEEDOT.description: It hangs off branches and absorbs nutrients. When it finishes eating, its body becomes so heavy that it drops to the ground with a thump.

SPECIES_NUZLEAF.name: Nuzleaf
SPECIES_NUZLEAF.description: A forest-dwelling Pokémon that is skilled at climbing trees. Its long and pointed nose is its weak point. It loses power if the nose is gripped.

SPECIES_SHIFTRY.name: Shiftry
SPECIES_SHIFTRY.description: It is said to arrive on chilly, wintry winds. Feared from long ago as the guardian of forests, this Pokémon lives in a deep forest where people do not venture.

SPECIES_TAILLOW.name: Taillow
SPECIES_TAILLOW.description: Although it is small, it is very courageous. It will take on a larger Skarmory on an equal footing. However, its will weakens if it becomes hungry.

SPECIES_SWELLOW.name: Swellow
SPECIES_SWELLOW.description: A Swellow dives upon prey from far above. It never misses its targets. It takes to the skies in search of lands with a warm climate.

SPECIES_TAILLOW_LOGI.name: Taillow
SPECIES_TAILLOW_LOGI.description: Its feathers are prized in some cultures as a comforting memento that one is being watched over from above.

SPECIES_SWELLOW_LOGI.name: Swellow
SPECIES_SWELLOW_LOGI.description: They are generally a benign sight respected in many lands. It is said the souls of the departed refract off their feathers forming a dazzling myriad of colors.

SPECIES_WINGULL.name: Wingull
SPECIES_WINGULL.description: It makes its nest on a sheer cliff at the edge of the sea. It has trouble keeping its wings flapping in flight. Instead, it soars on updrafts.

SPECIES_PELIPPER.name: Pelipper
SPECIES_PELIPPER.description: It skims the tops of waves as it flies. When it spots prey, it uses its large beak to scoop up the victim with water. It protects its eggs in its beak.

SPECIES_RALTS.name: Ralts
SPECIES_RALTS.description: A Ralts has the power to sense the emotions of people and Pokémon with the horns on its head. It takes cover if it senses any hostility.

SPECIES_KIRLIA.name: Kirlia
SPECIES_KIRLIA.description: A Kirlia has the psychic power to create a rip in the dimensions and see into the future. It is said to dance with pleasure on sunny mornings.

SPECIES_GARDEVOIR.name: Gardevoir
SPECIES_GARDEVOIR.description: It apparently does not feel the pull of gravity because it supports itself with psychic power. It will give its life to protect its Trainer.

SPECIES_GARDEVOIR_MEGA.name: Gardevoir
SPECIES_GARDEVOIR_MEGA.description: By opening its heart, Mega Gardevoir becomes able to use tremendous psychic power. The red plate in its chest is said to be a physical manifestation of its heart.

SPECIES_GALLADE.name: Gallade
SPECIES_GALLADE.description: A master of courtesy and swordsmanship, it fights using extending swords on its elbows when trying to protect someone. It can sense what its foe is thinking.

SPECIES_GALLADE_MEGA.name: Gallade
SPECIES_GALLADE_MEGA.description: Mega Gallade has a knightly appearance. It can use its psychic power to reshape both arms into blades simultaneously and fight using a dual-wielding style.

SPECIES_SURSKIT.name: Surskit
SPECIES_SURSKIT.description: They gather on puddles after evening downpours, gliding across the surface of water as if sliding. It secretes honey with a sweet aroma from its head.

SPECIES_MASQUERAIN.name: Masquerain
SPECIES_MASQUERAIN.description: It intimidates foes with the large eyelike patterns on its antennae. Because it can't fly if its wings get wet, it shelters itself from rain under large trees and eaves.

SPECIES_SHROOMISH.name: Shroomish
SPECIES_SHROOMISH.description: It loves to eat damp, composted soil in forests. If you enter a forest after a long rain, you can see many Shroomish feasting on composted soil.

SPECIES_BRELOOM.name: Breloom
SPECIES_BRELOOM.description: It scatters spores from holes in the cap on its head. It loves warm and humid climates. It feeds on trees and plants in fields and forests.

SPECIES_SLAKOTH.name: Slakoth
SPECIES_SLAKOTH.description: It sleeps virtually all day and night long. It doesn't change its nest its entire life, but it sometimes travels great distances by swimming in rivers.

SPECIES_VIGOROTH.name: Vigoroth
SPECIES_VIGOROTH.description: It can't keep still because its blood boils with energy. It runs through the fields and mountains all day to calm itself. If it doesn't, it can't sleep at night.

SPECIES_SLAKING.name: Slaking
SPECIES_SLAKING.description: Hordes of Slaking gather around trees when fruits come into season. They wait around patiently for ripened fruits to fall out of the trees.

SPECIES_NINCADA.name: Nincada
SPECIES_NINCADA.description: It makes its nest at the roots of a mighty tree. Using its whiskerlike antennae, it probes its surroundings in the pitch-black darkness of soil.

SPECIES_NINJASK.name: Ninjask
SPECIES_NINJASK.description: Because it darts about vigorously at high speed, it is very difficult to see. Hearing its distinctive cries for too long induces a headache.

SPECIES_SHEDINJA.name: Shedinja
SPECIES_SHEDINJA.description: A peculiar Pokémon that floats in air even though its wings remain completely still. The inside of its body is hollow and utterly dark.

SPECIES_WHISMUR.name: Whismur
SPECIES_WHISMUR.description: Its cries equal a jet plane in volume. It inhales through its ear canals. Because of this system, it can cry continually without having to catch its breath.

SPECIES_LOUDRED.name: Loudred
SPECIES_LOUDRED.description: It positions the round speakers on its head to assail foes with ultrasonic waves at massive volume. It builds power by stomping the ground.

SPECIES_EXPLOUD.name: Exploud
SPECIES_EXPLOUD.description: It has sound-generating organs all over its body. It communicates with others by adjusting the tone and volume of the cries it emits.

SPECIES_MAKUHITA.name: Makuhita
SPECIES_MAKUHITA.description: It loves to toughen up its body above all else. If you hear quaking rumbles in a cave, it is the sound of Makuhita undertaking strenuous training.

SPECIES_HARIYAMA.name: Hariyama
SPECIES_HARIYAMA.description: It has the habit of challenging others without hesitation to tests of strength. It's been known to stand on train tracks and stop trains using forearm thrusts.

SPECIES_NOSEPASS.name: Nosepass
SPECIES_NOSEPASS.description: Its body emits a powerful magnetism. It feeds on prey that is pulled in by the force. Its magnetism is stronger in cold seasons.

SPECIES_PROBOPASS.name: Probopass
SPECIES_PROBOPASS.description: It freely controls three units called Mini-Noses using magnetic force. With them, it can attack its foes from three directions.

SPECIES_SKITTY.name: Skitty
SPECIES_SKITTY.description: A Skitty's adorably cute behavior makes it highly popular. In battle, it makes its tail puff out. It threatens foes with a sharp growl.

SPECIES_DELCATTY.name: Delcatty
SPECIES_DELCATTY.description: Rather than keeping a permanent lair, it habitually seeks comfortable spots and sleeps there. It is nocturnal and becomes active at dusk.

SPECIES_SABLEYE.name: Sableye
SPECIES_SABLEYE.description: It digs branching holes in caves using its sharp claws in search of food--raw gems. A Sableye lurks in darkness and is seen only rarely.

SPECIES_SABLEYE_MEGA.name: Sableye
SPECIES_SABLEYE_MEGA.description: Bathed in the energy of Mega Evolution, the gemstone on its chest expands, rips through its skin, and falls out.

SPECIES_MAWILE.name: Mawile
SPECIES_MAWILE.description: Its giant jaws are actually steel horns that transformed. It fools foes into complacency with its adorable gestures, then chomps them with its huge jaws.

SPECIES_MAWILE_MEGA.name: Mawile
SPECIES_MAWILE_MEGA.description: Its two sets of jaws thrash about violently as if they each had a will of their own. One gnash from them can turn a boulder to dust.

SPECIES_ARON.name: Aron
SPECIES_ARON.description: A Pokémon that is clad in steel armor. A new suit of armor is made when it evolves. The old, discarded armor is salvaged as metal for making iron products.

SPECIES_LAIRON.name: Lairon
SPECIES_LAIRON.description: When two Lairon meet in the wild, they fight for territory by bashing into each other with their steel bodies. The sound of their collision carries for miles.

SPECIES_AGGRON.name: Aggron
SPECIES_AGGRON.description: Its iron horns grow longer a little at a time. They are used to determine the Aggron's age. The gouges in its armor are worn with pride as mementos from battles.

SPECIES_AGGRON_MEGA.name: Aggron
SPECIES_AGGRON_MEGA.description: When Aggron Mega Evolves into Mega Aggron, the destructive ability of its fearsome horns can turn a steel-clad tank into so much scrap metal.

SPECIES_MEDITITE.name: Meditite
SPECIES_MEDITITE.description: It continually meditates for hours every day. As a result of rigorous and dedicated yoga training, it has tempered its spiritual power so much it can fly.

SPECIES_MEDICHAM.name: Medicham
SPECIES_MEDICHAM.description: Through crushingly harsh yoga training, it gained the power to foretell its foe's actions. It battles with elegant, dance- like movement.

SPECIES_MEDICHAM_MEGA.name: Medicham
SPECIES_MEDICHAM_MEGA.description: It uses its amped-up willpower to create additional arms for itself. The more it has trained its spirit, the more realistic and dexterous these arms become.

SPECIES_ELECTRIKE.name: Electrike
SPECIES_ELECTRIKE.description: It generates electricity using friction from the atmosphere. In seasons with especially arid air, its entire body blazes with violent showers of sparks.

SPECIES_MANECTRIC.name: Manectric
SPECIES_MANECTRIC.description: Because lightning falls in their vicinities, Manectric were thought to have been born from lightning. In battle, they create thunderclouds.

SPECIES_MANECTRIC_MEGA.name: Manectric
SPECIES_MANECTRIC_MEGA.description: Too much electricity has built up in its body, irritating Manectric. Its explosive speed is equal to that of a lightning bolt.

SPECIES_PLUSLE.name: Plusle
SPECIES_PLUSLE.description: It has the trait of cheering on its fellow Pokémon. By shorting out the electricity it releases from its paws, it creates pom-poms for cheering.

SPECIES_MINUN.name: Minun
SPECIES_MINUN.description: At a meeting of Pokémon academics, it was announced that simultaneous exposure to electricity from a Plusle and Minun will promote circulation and boost vitality.

SPECIES_VOLBEAT.name: Volbeat
SPECIES_VOLBEAT.description: With their taillights lit, Volbeat fly in a swarm, drawing geometric designs in the night sky. They move their nests if their pond water becomes dirty.

SPECIES_ILLUMISE.name: Illumise
SPECIES_ILLUMISE.description: A nocturnal Pokémon that becomes active upon nightfall. It leads a Volbeat swarm to draw patterns in the night sky. Over 200 different patterns have been confirmed.

SPECIES_BUDEW.name: Budew
SPECIES_BUDEW.description: Over the winter, it closes its bud and endures the cold. Sensitive to changing temperature, the bud is said to bloom when it feels the sun's warm touch.

SPECIES_ROSELIA.name: Roselia
SPECIES_ROSELIA.description: A Roselia that drinks nutritionally rich springwater blooms with lovely flowers. The fragrance of its flowers has the effect of making its foes careless.

SPECIES_ROSERADE.name: Roserade
SPECIES_ROSERADE.description: Its sweet aroma attracts prey. With the movements of a dancer, it strikes with whips that are densely lined with poison thorns.

SPECIES_GULPIN.name: Gulpin
SPECIES_GULPIN.description: This Pokémon's stomach fluid can even digest scrap iron. In one gulp, it can swallow something that is as large as itself.

SPECIES_SWALOT.name: Swalot
SPECIES_SWALOT.description: Its powerful stomach acid is capable of digesting almost anything. The one thing in the whole world a Swalot can't digest is its own stomach.

SPECIES_CARVANHA.name: Carvanha
SPECIES_CARVANHA.description: Carvanha attack ships in swarms, making them sink. Although it is said to be a very vicious Pokémon, it timidly flees as soon as it finds itself alone.

SPECIES_SHARPEDO.name: Sharpedo
SPECIES_SHARPEDO.description: The vicious and sly gangster of the sea. Its skin is specially textured to minimize drag in water. Its speed tops out at over 75 miles per hour.

SPECIES_SHARPEDO_MEGA.name: Sharpedo
SPECIES_SHARPEDO_MEGA.description: The yellow patterns it bears are old scars. The energy from Mega Evolution runs through them, causing it sharp pain and suffering.

SPECIES_WAILMER.name: Wailmer
SPECIES_WAILMER.description: While this Pokémon usually lives in the sea, it can survive on land, although not too long. It loses vitality if its body becomes dried out.

SPECIES_WAILORD.name: Wailord
SPECIES_WAILORD.description: It breathes through nostrils that it raises above the sea. By inhaling to its maximum capacity, a Wailord can dive close to 10,000 feet beneath the waves.

SPECIES_NUMEL.name: Numel
SPECIES_NUMEL.description: A Numel stores boiling magma in the hump on its back. It is a hardy Pokémon that can transport a 220-pound load. It has served humans at work since long ago.

SPECIES_CAMERUPT.name: Camerupt
SPECIES_CAMERUPT.description: A Pokémon that lives in the crater of a volcano. Every 10 years, the volcanoes on its back erupt violently. Research is under way on the cause of eruption.

SPECIES_CAMERUPT_MEGA.name: Camerupt
SPECIES_CAMERUPT_MEGA.description: The humps on its back have transformed into one large and very active volcano. It has a deep hatred of water or any moisture and has an explosive personality.

SPECIES_TORKOAL.name: Torkoal
SPECIES_TORKOAL.description: It battles using energy it gets from burning coal. When loosing smoke from its nostrils, it lets off a sound that is similar to a locomotive's horn.

SPECIES_SPOINK.name: Spoink
SPECIES_SPOINK.description: A Pokémon that manipulates psychic power at will. It doesn't stop bouncing even when it is asleep. It loves eating mushrooms that grow underground.

SPECIES_GRUMPIG.name: Grumpig
SPECIES_GRUMPIG.description: It stores power in the black pearls on its forehead. When it uses psychic power, it performs an odd dance step. Its style of dancing became hugely popular overseas.

SPECIES_SPINDA.name: Spinda
SPECIES_SPINDA.description: It is distinguished by a pattern of spots that is always different. Its unsteady, tottering walk has the effect of fouling its foe's aim.

SPECIES_TRAPINCH.name: Trapinch
SPECIES_TRAPINCH.description: Its big jaws crunch through boulders. Because its head is so big, it has a hard time getting back upright if it tips over onto its back.

SPECIES_VIBRAVA.name: Vibrava
SPECIES_VIBRAVA.description: It looses ultrasonic waves by rubbing its wings together. Since a Vibrava's wings are still in the process of growing, it can only fly short distances.

SPECIES_FLYGON.name: Flygon
SPECIES_FLYGON.description: The flapping of its wings sounds like singing. To prevent detection by enemies, it hides itself by flapping up a cloud of desert sand.

SPECIES_CACNEA.name: Cacnea
SPECIES_CACNEA.description: Cacnea live in deserts with virtually no rainfall. It battles by swinging its thick, spiked arms. Once a year, a yellow flower blooms.

SPECIES_CACTURNE.name: Cacturne
SPECIES_CACTURNE.description: After spending thousands of years in harsh deserts, its blood transformed into the same substances as sand. It is nocturnal, so it hunts at night.

SPECIES_SWABLU.name: Swablu
SPECIES_SWABLU.description: A Pokémon that has wings like cottony clouds. After enduring winter, in which little food is available, Swablu flocks move closer to towns in the spring.

SPECIES_ALTARIA.name: Altaria
SPECIES_ALTARIA.description: It hums in a beautiful soprano voice. It flies among white clouds in the blue sky. It launches intensely hot fireballs from its mouth.

SPECIES_ALTARIA_MEGA.name: Altaria
SPECIES_ALTARIA_MEGA.description: It sings with a voice that is even more beautiful than before it Mega Evolved. Its feathers became larger for protection and glimmer with an iridescent sheen.

SPECIES_ZANGOOSE.name: Zangoose
SPECIES_ZANGOOSE.description: When it battles, it stands on its hind legs and attacks with its sharply clawed forelegs. Its fur bristles if it encounters any Seviper.

SPECIES_SEVIPER.name: Seviper
SPECIES_SEVIPER.description: Seviper and Zangoose are eternal rivals. It counters a Zangoose's dazzling agility with its swordlike tail, which also oozes a horrible poison.

SPECIES_LUNATONE.name: Lunatone
SPECIES_LUNATONE.description: It becomes very active on the night of a full moon. This Pokémon was first discovered 40 years ago at the site of a meteor strike.

SPECIES_SOLROCK.name: Solrock
SPECIES_SOLROCK.description: Solar energy is the source of this Pokémon's power. On sunny days, groups of Solrock line up facing the sun and absorb its light.

SPECIES_BARBOACH.name: Barboach
SPECIES_BARBOACH.description: Its body is covered with a slimy film. The film acts as a barrier to prevent germs in muddy water from entering the Barboach's body.

SPECIES_WHISCASH.name: Whiscash
SPECIES_WHISCASH.description: Mysteriously, it can foretell earthquakes. In the daytime, it sleeps in mud at the bottom of a pond. When it awakens, it continually feeds throughout the night.

SPECIES_CORPHISH.name: Corphish
SPECIES_CORPHISH.description: Once it grips prey with its large pincers, it will never let go, no matter what. It is a hardy Pokémon that can thrive in any environment.

SPECIES_CRAWDAUNT.name: Crawdaunt
SPECIES_CRAWDAUNT.description: A brutish Pokémon that loves to battle. A veteran Crawdaunt that has prevailed in hundreds of battles has giant pincers marked with countless scars.

SPECIES_BALTOY.name: Baltoy
SPECIES_BALTOY.description: A Baltoy moves by spinning on its single foot. It has been depicted in murals adorning the walls of a once-bustling city in an ancient age.

SPECIES_CLAYDOL.name: Claydol
SPECIES_CLAYDOL.description: A Claydol sleeps while hovering in midair. Its arms are separate from its body. They are kept floating by the Pokémon's manipulation of psychic power.

SPECIES_LILEEP.name: Lileep
SPECIES_LILEEP.description: It disguises itself as seaweed by making its tentacles sway. Unsuspecting prey that come too close are swallowed whole. It became extinct 100 million years ago.

SPECIES_CRADILY.name: Cradily
SPECIES_CRADILY.description: It drags its heavy body along the seafloor. It makes its nest in the shallows of warm seas. Cradily can be seen on beaches when the tide goes out.

SPECIES_ANORITH.name: Anorith
SPECIES_ANORITH.description: It was resurrected from a fossil using the power of science. It swims by undulating the eight wings at its sides. They were feet that adapted to life in the sea.

SPECIES_ARMALDO.name: Armaldo
SPECIES_ARMALDO.description: Armaldo usually lives on land. However, when it hunts for prey, it dives beneath the ocean. It swims around using its two large wings.

SPECIES_FEEBAS.name: Feebas
SPECIES_FEEBAS.description: Feebas live in ponds that are heavily infested with weeds. Because of its hopelessly shabby appearance, it seems as if few Trainers raise it.

SPECIES_MILOTIC.name: Milotic
SPECIES_MILOTIC.description: It is said to live at the bottom of large lakes. Considered to be the most beautiful of all Pokémon, it has been depicted in paintings and statues.

SPECIES_CASTFORM_NORMAL.name: Castform
SPECIES_CASTFORM_NORMAL.description: It alters its form depending on the weather. Changes in the climate such as the temperature and humidity appear to affect its cellular structure.

SPECIES_CASTFORM_SUNNY.name: Castform
SPECIES_CASTFORM_SUNNY.description: Castform takes this form on bright days. In an experiment where is was placed in front of a heater, it didn't change to this form. Its body is warm and toasty.

SPECIES_CASTFORM_RAINY.name: Castform
SPECIES_CASTFORM_RAINY.description: This is Castform's form while it's raining. In an experiment where it was placed in a shower, it didn't change to this form. Its body is soft, slightly swollen with water.

SPECIES_CASTFORM_SNOWY.name: Castform
SPECIES_CASTFORM_SNOWY.description: This is Castform's form in a hailstorm. In an experiment where it was placed in a freezer, it didn't change to this form. Its cold skin is as smooth as ice.

SPECIES_KECLEON.name: Kecleon
SPECIES_KECLEON.description: A Pokémon that has the ability to alter its body colors to match its surroundings. A Kecleon reverts to its original colors if it is startled.

SPECIES_SHUPPET.name: Shuppet
SPECIES_SHUPPET.description: This Pokémon roams about deep in the night seeking such negative emotions as grudges and envy. It retreats to its nest when the sun begins to rise.

SPECIES_BANETTE.name: Banette
SPECIES_BANETTE.description: An abandoned plush doll became this Pokémon. They are said to live in garbage dumps and wander about in search of the children that threw them away.

SPECIES_BANETTE_MEGA.name: Banette
SPECIES_BANETTE_MEGA.description: Extraordinary energy amplifies its cursing power to such an extent that it can't help but curse its own Trainer.

SPECIES_DUSKULL.name: Duskull
SPECIES_DUSKULL.description: A glare from its single scarlet eye makes even burly grown-ups freeze in utter fear. It is a nocturnal Pokémon that roams about under the cloak of darkness.

SPECIES_DUSCLOPS.name: Dusclops
SPECIES_DUSCLOPS.description: It is thought that its body is hollow with only a spectral ball of fire burning inside. However, no one has been able to confirm this theory as fact.

SPECIES_DUSKNOIR.name: Dusknoir
SPECIES_DUSKNOIR.description: This feared Pokémon is said to travel to worlds unknown. Some even believe that it takes lost spirits into its pliant body and guides them home.

SPECIES_TROPIUS.name: Tropius
SPECIES_TROPIUS.description: It flies by flapping its broad leaves. The bunch of fruit that grows around its neck is deliciously sweet. In the spring, it scatters pollen from its neck.

SPECIES_CHINGLING.name: Chingling
SPECIES_CHINGLING.description: There is an orb inside its mouth. When it hops, the orb bounces all over and makes a ringing sound. It can cry for an awfully long time.

SPECIES_CHIMECHO.name: Chimecho
SPECIES_CHIMECHO.description: They fly about very actively when the hot season arrives. They communicate among themselves using seven different and distinguishing cries.

SPECIES_ABSOL.name: Absol
SPECIES_ABSOL.description: It sharply senses even subtle changes in the sky and the land to predict natural disasters. It is a long-lived Pokémon that has a life-span of 100 years.

SPECIES_ABSOL_MEGA.name: Absol
SPECIES_ABSOL_MEGA.description: As the energy of Mega Evolution fills it, its fur bristles. What you see on its back are not true wings, and this Pokémon isn't able to fly.

SPECIES_SNORUNT.name: Snorunt
SPECIES_SNORUNT.description: They tend to move about in groups of around five Snorunt. In snowy regions, it is said that when they are seen late at night, snowfall will arrive by morning.

locations.map: Shoal Cave Low Tide Ice Room

SPECIES_GLALIE.name: Glalie
SPECIES_GLALIE.description: A Glalie has the power to instantaneously freeze moisture in the atmosphere. A dazzling cloud of diamondlike ice crystals forms around its body.

SPECIES_GLALIE_MEGA.name: Glalie
SPECIES_GLALIE_MEGA.description: The power of Mega Evolution was so strong that it smashed Glalie's jaw. Its inability to eat very well leaves Glalie irritated.

SPECIES_FROSLASS.name: Froslass
SPECIES_FROSLASS.description: When it finds people or Pokémon it likes, it freezes them and takes them to its chilly den, where they become its decorations.

SPECIES_SPHEAL.name: Spheal
SPECIES_SPHEAL.description: It is completely covered with plushy fur. As a result, it never feels the cold even when it is rolling about on ice floes or diving in the sea.
