SPECIES_SEALEO.name: Sealeo
SPECIES_SEALEO.description: Sealeo live in herds on ice floes. Using its powerful flippers, it shatters ice. It dives into the sea to hunt prey five times a day.

SPECIES_WALREIN.name: Walrein
SPECIES_WALREIN.description: To protect its herd, the leader battles anything that invades its territory, even at the cost of its life. Its tusks may snap off in battle.

SPECIES_CLAMPERL.name: Clamperl
SPECIES_CLAMPERL.description: A Clamperl slams its shell closed on prey to prevent escape. The pearl it creates upon evolution is said to be infused with a mysterious energy.

SPECIES_HUNTAIL.name: Huntail
SPECIES_HUNTAIL.description: To withstand the crushing pressure of water deep under the sea, its spine is very thick and sturdy. Its tail, which is shaped like a small fish, has eyes that light up.

SPECIES_GOREBYSS.name: Gorebyss
SPECIES_GOREBYSS.description: A Gorebyss siphons the body fluids of prey through its thin, tubular mouth. Its light pink body color turns vivid when it finishes feeding.

SPECIES_RELICANTH.name: Relicanth
SPECIES_RELICANTH.description: A Pokémon that was once believed to have been extinct. The species has not changed its form for 100 million years. It walks on the seafloor using its pectoral fins.

SPECIES_LUVDISC.name: Luvdisc
SPECIES_LUVDISC.description: Luvdisc make the branches of Corsola their nests. There is a custom from long ago of giving a Luvdisc as a gift to express one's feelings of love.

SPECIES_BAGON.name: Bagon
SPECIES_BAGON.description: Although it is small, this Pokémon is very powerful because its body is a bundle of muscles. It launches head-butts with its ironlike skull.

SPECIES_SHELGON.name: Shelgon
SPECIES_SHELGON.description: It hardly eats while it awaits evolution. It becomes hardier by enduring hunger. Its shell peels off the instant it begins to evolve.

SPECIES_SALAMENCE.name: Salamence
SPECIES_SALAMENCE.description: After many long years, its cellular structure underwent a sudden mutation to grow wings. When angered, it loses all thought and rampages out of control.

SPECIES_SALAMENCE_MEGA.name: Salamence
SPECIES_SALAMENCE_MEGA.description: Mega Evolution fuels its brutality, and it may even turn on the Trainer who raised it. It's been dubbed the blood-soaked. crescent.

SPECIES_BELDUM.name: Beldum
SPECIES_BELDUM.description: When Beldum gather in a swarm, they move in perfect unison as if they were but one Pokémon. They communicate with each other using brain waves.

SPECIES_METANG.name: Metang
SPECIES_METANG.description: The claws tipping its arms pack the destructive power to tear through thick iron sheets as if they were silk. It flies at over 60 miles per hour.

SPECIES_METAGROSS.name: Metagross
SPECIES_METAGROSS.description: Metagross has four brains that are joined by a complex neural network. As a result of integration, this Pokémon is smarter than a supercomputer.

SPECIES_METAGROSS_MEGA.name: Metagross
SPECIES_METAGROSS_MEGA.description: When it knows it can't win, it digs the claws on its legs into its opponent and starts the countdown to a big explosion.

SPECIES_REGIROCK.name: Regirock
SPECIES_REGIROCK.description: A Pokémon that is made entirely of rocks and boulders. If parts of its body chip off in battle, Regirock repairs itself by adding new rocks.

SPECIES_REGICE.name: Regice
SPECIES_REGICE.description: Its entire body is made of Antarctic ice. After extensive studies, researchers believe the ice was formed during an ice age.

SPECIES_REGISTEEL.name: Registeel
SPECIES_REGISTEEL.description: Its body is harder than any other kind of metal. The body metal is composed of a mysterious substance. Not only is it hard, it shrinks and stretches flexibly.

SPECIES_LATIAS.name: Latias
SPECIES_LATIAS.description: They make a small herd of only several members. They rarely make contact with people or other Pokémon. They disappear if they sense enemies.

SPECIES_LATIAS_LOGI.name: Latias
SPECIES_LATIAS_LOGI.description: It has a menacing disposition and spirit that manifests as crackling currents. It can overwhelm its enemies with a storm of negativity.

SPECIES_LATIAS_MEGA.name: Latias
SPECIES_LATIAS_MEGA.description: Its body is smaller than Mega Latios's body. It is more agile and can make very sharp turns. When it Mega Evolves, its defensive strength grows substantially.

SPECIES_LATIOS.name: Latios
SPECIES_LATIOS.description: Even in hiding, it can detect the locations of others and sense their emotions since it has telepathy. Its intelligence allows it to understand human languages.

SPECIES_LATIOS_LOGI.name: Latios
SPECIES_LATIOS_LOGI.description: It has a seemingly cruel intelligence in how it fights. If it can't manage to defeat an opponent, it will hold an eternal grudge against them.

SPECIES_LATIOS_MEGA.name: Latios
SPECIES_LATIOS_MEGA.description: It's larger than Mega Latias, and can achieve higher speeds in flight. This Pokémon can use its speed in battle to unleash a flurry of attacks.

SPECIES_KYOGRE.name: Kyogre
SPECIES_KYOGRE.description: Kyogre has appeared in mythology as the creator of the sea. After long years of feuding with Groudon, it took to sleep at the bottom of the sea.

SPECIES_KYOGRE_PRIMAL.name: Kyogre
SPECIES_KYOGRE_PRIMAL.description: When Kyogre roared, water poured forth and the seas spread outward. Dark clouds enshrouded the world, and the deluge fell upon all…

SPECIES_GROUDON.name: Groudon
SPECIES_GROUDON.description: Groudon has appeared in mythology as the creator of the land. It sleeps in magma underground and is said to make volcanoes erupt on awakening.

SPECIES_GROUDON_PRIMAL.name: Groudon
SPECIES_GROUDON_PRIMAL.description: When Groudon howled, the earth swelled and the land grew wide. The sun blazed atop and all the world around the creature was enveloped in incandescent heat.

SPECIES_RAYQUAZA.name: Rayquaza
SPECIES_RAYQUAZA.description: A Pokémon that flies endlessly in the ozone layer. It is said it would descend to the ground if Kyogre and Groudon were to fight.

SPECIES_RAYQUAZA_MEGA.name: Rayquaza
SPECIES_RAYQUAZA_MEGA.description: Particles stream from the filaments that extend from its jaw. They can control the density and humidity of the air, allowing Rayquaza to manipulate the weather.

SPECIES_JIRACHI.name: Jirachi
SPECIES_JIRACHI.description: Jirachi is said to make wishes come true. While it sleeps, a tough crystalline shell envelops the body to protect it from enemies.

SPECIES_TURTWIG.name: Turtwig
SPECIES_TURTWIG.description: The shell on its back is made of soil. On a very healthy Turtwig, the shell should feel moist. The leaf on its head wilts if it is thirsty.

SPECIES_GROTLE.name: Grotle
SPECIES_GROTLE.description: A Grotle that lives in the forest is said to have its own secret springwater well. It carries fellow Pokémon there on its back.

SPECIES_TORTERRA.name: Torterra
SPECIES_TORTERRA.description: Some Pokémon are born on a Torterra's back and spend their entire life there. Ancient people imagined that beneath the ground, a gigantic Torterra dwelled.

SPECIES_TORTERRA_MEGA.name: Torterra
SPECIES_TORTERRA_MEGA.description: Its ancient blood has been awoken by Mega Evolution, stumping experts everywhere on its true origins - and how it ever arrived to Sinnoh.

SPECIES_CHIMCHAR.name: Chimchar
SPECIES_CHIMCHAR.description: Its fiery rear end is fueled by gas made in its belly. Before going to sleep, Chimchar extinguish the flame on their tails to prevent fires.

SPECIES_MONFERNO.name: Monferno
SPECIES_MONFERNO.description: It carefully controls the intensity of the flame on its tail, so as to keep its foes at an adequate distance. Its fiery tail is but one weapon.

SPECIES_INFERNAPE.name: Infernape
SPECIES_INFERNAPE.description: Its crown of fire is indicative of its fiery nature. It uses a special kind of martial arts involving all of its limbs to take on any opponent.

SPECIES_PIPLUP.name: Piplup
SPECIES_PIPLUP.description: A poor walker, it often falls down. However, its strong pride makes it puff up its chest without a care. It's difficult to bond with since it won't listen to its Trainer.

SPECIES_PRINPLUP.name: Prinplup
SPECIES_PRINPLUP.description: Because every Prinplup considers itself to be the most important, they can never form a group. It searches for prey in icy seas.

SPECIES_EMPOLEON.name: Empoleon
SPECIES_EMPOLEON.description: The three horns that extend from its beak attest to its power. It avoids unnecessary disputes, but it will decimate anything that threatens its pride.

SPECIES_STARLY.name: Starly
SPECIES_STARLY.description: They flock around mountains and fields, chasing after bug Pokémon. However, they bicker if the group grows too big. Their singing is noisy and annoying.

SPECIES_STARAVIA.name: Staravia
SPECIES_STARAVIA.description: Recognizing their own weakness, they maintain huge flocks. Fierce scuffles break out between various flocks. When alone, a Staravia cries noisily.

SPECIES_STARAPTOR.name: Staraptor
SPECIES_STARAPTOR.description: When Staravia evolve into Staraptor, they leave the flock to live alone. It has a savage nature. It will courageously challenge foes that are much larger.

SPECIES_BIDOOF.name: Bidoof
SPECIES_BIDOOF.description: A comparison revealed that Bidoof's front teeth grow at the same rate as Rattata's. It constantly gnaws on logs and rocks to whittle down its front teeth.

SPECIES_BIBAREL.name: Bibarel
SPECIES_BIBAREL.description: It makes its nest by damming streams with bark and mud. A river dammed by Bibarel will never overflow its banks, which is appreciated by people nearby.

SPECIES_KRICKETOT.name: Kricketot
SPECIES_KRICKETOT.description: It shakes its head back to front, causing its antennae to hit each other and sound like a xylophone. These sounds are fall hallmarks.

SPECIES_KRICKETUNE.name: Kricketune
SPECIES_KRICKETUNE.description: It signals its emotions with its melodies. There is a village that hosts a contest based on the amazingly variable cries of this Pokémon.

SPECIES_SHINX.name: Shinx
SPECIES_SHINX.description: It rapidly contracts and relaxes its muscles to generate electricity. Its body shines if endangered. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.

SPECIES_LUXIO.name: Luxio
SPECIES_LUXIO.description: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch has enough amperage to cause fainting in foes.

SPECIES_LUXRAY.name: Luxray
SPECIES_LUXRAY.description: It has eyes which can see through anything. Luxray's ability to see through objects comes in handy when it's scouting for danger.

SPECIES_CRANIDOS.name: Cranidos
SPECIES_CRANIDOS.description: A lifelong jungle dweller from 100 million years ago, its skull is as hard as iron. It would snap obstructing trees with headbutts.

SPECIES_RAMPARDOS.name: Rampardos
SPECIES_RAMPARDOS.description: The result of repeated headbutts is a skull grown thick and hard. However, its brain has shrunk in size compared with Cranidos's.

SPECIES_SHIELDON.name: Shieldon
SPECIES_SHIELDON.description: This Pokémon lived in primeval jungles. Few enemies would have been willing to square off against its heavily armored face, so it's thought.

SPECIES_BASTIODON.name: Bastiodon
SPECIES_BASTIODON.description: Their rock-hard faces serve to protect them from any frontral attacks. When attacked, they form a wall. They shielded their young in that way.

SPECIES_BURMY_PLANT.name: Burmy
SPECIES_BURMY_PLANT.description: If its cloak is even slightly damaged, it will immediately repair it with whatever is near at hand. The Pokémon within the cloak is scrawny and vulnerable to the cold.

SPECIES_BURMY_SANDY.name: Burmy
SPECIES_BURMY_SANDY.description: It weaves a cloak together with sand, mud, and silk it spits out. This earthen cloak is ruined by wind and rain, so the Pokémon hides away in caves and other such places.

SPECIES_BURMY_TRASH.name: Burmy
SPECIES_BURMY_TRASH.description: When confronted by a lack of other materials, Burmy will create its cloak using dust and refuse. The cloak seems to be more comfortable than one would think.

SPECIES_WORMADAM_PLANT.name: Wormadam
SPECIES_WORMADAM_PLANT.description: Its appearance changes depending on where Burmy evolved. The materials on hand become a part of its body. The cloak is never shed.

SPECIES_WORMADAM_SANDY.name: Wormadam
SPECIES_WORMADAM_SANDY.description: Its earthen skin is reasonably hard, it has no problem repelling a Starly's pecking. It is said that a Wormadam that evolves on a cold day will have a thicker cloak.

SPECIES_WORMADAM_TRASH.name: Wormadam
SPECIES_WORMADAM_TRASH.description: Its body, composed of refuse, blends in to the scenery enough to be inconspicuous. This seems to be the perfect way for it to evade the detection of predators.

SPECIES_COMBEE.name: Combee
SPECIES_COMBEE.description: A Pokémon formed by three others. It constantly gathers honey from flowers to please Vespiquen. At night, they cluster to form a beehive and sleep.

SPECIES_VESPIQUEN.name: Vespiquen
SPECIES_VESPIQUEN.description: It houses its colony in cells in its body and releases various pheromones to make those grubs do its bidding. There is only one in a colony.

SPECIES_PACHIRISU.name: Pachirisu
SPECIES_PACHIRISU.description: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity. It stores them with berries in tree holes.

SPECIES_BUIZEL.name: Buizel
SPECIES_BUIZEL.description: It inflates its flotation sac, keeping its face above water in order to watch for prey movement. It swims by rotating its two tails like a screw.

SPECIES_FLOATZEL.name: Floatzel
SPECIES_FLOATZEL.description: Its flotation sac developed as a result of pursuing aquatic prey. It can double as a rubber raft. It assists in the rescues of drowning people.

SPECIES_CHERUBI.name: Cherubi
SPECIES_CHERUBI.description: The small ball holds the nutrients needed for evolution. Apparently, it is also very sweet and tasty. Pokémon like Starly and Taillow try to peck it off.

SPECIES_CHERRIM_OVERCAST.name: Cherrim
SPECIES_CHERRIM_OVERCAST.description: It's motionless, save for the occasional quiver. A rich array of Pokémon can be found gathered around it, drawn by the scent exuded from Cherrim's folded petals.

SPECIES_CHERRIM_SUNSHINE.name: Cherrim
SPECIES_CHERRIM_SUNSHINE.description: Cherrim takes this form on sunny days. Its faint scent entices bug Pokémon to it. It immediately closes its petals and becomes immobile once the sun hides.

SPECIES_SHELLOS_WEST.name: Shellos
SPECIES_SHELLOS_WEST.description: It oozes a purple fluid to deter enemies. While harmless, the fluid is awfully sticky. Apparently, there are more West Sea Shellos now than there were in the past.

SPECIES_SHELLOS_EAST.name: Shellos
SPECIES_SHELLOS_EAST.description: It's capable of spending a limited amount of time on land until their skin dries out. One theory suggests that living in cold seas causes Shellos to take on this form.

SPECIES_GASTRODON_WEST.name: Gastrodon
SPECIES_GASTRODON_WEST.description: It appears on shallow-water beaches to eat sand for nourishment. Should one Gastrodon encounter another of a different color, a fierce battle will ensue.

SPECIES_GASTRODON_EAST.name: Gastrodon
SPECIES_GASTRODON_EAST.description: Found more often on land than in the sea. They normally live in rocky seashores, but when cloudy or rainy, they can sometimes be found on mountains, far from the sea.

SPECIES_DRIFLOON.name: Drifloon
SPECIES_DRIFLOON.description: Because of the way it floats aimlessly, an old folktale calls it a “Signpost for Wandering Spirits.” Children holding them sometimes vanish.

SPECIES_DRIFBLIM.name: Drifblim
SPECIES_DRIFBLIM.description: Even while under careful observation, large flocks of Drifblim flying at dusk will inexplicably disappear from view. No one knows where they go.

SPECIES_DRIFLOON_LOGI.name: Drifloon
SPECIES_DRIFLOON_LOGI.description: It can spray an endless amount of water and seemingly never deflate - nobody is sure if it even contains water or just resembles a water balloon.

SPECIES_DRIFBLIM_LOGI.name: Drifblim
SPECIES_DRIFBLIM_LOGI.description: Sometimes, you may excitedly go outside to enjoy a forecasted clear sky, only for a pack of Drifblim to be floating aimlessly like clouds.

SPECIES_BUNEARY.name: Buneary
SPECIES_BUNEARY.description: You can tell how it feels by the way it rolls its ears. When it's scared, both ears are rolled up. When it senses danger, it perks them up.

SPECIES_LOPUNNY.name: Lopunny
SPECIES_LOPUNNY.description: An extremely cautious Pokémon. It is very conscious of its looks and never fails to groom its ears. It runs with sprightly jumps.

SPECIES_LOPUNNY_MEGA.name: Lopunny
SPECIES_LOPUNNY_MEGA.description: Mega Evolution awakens its combative instincts. It has shed any fur that got in the way of its attacks. crescent.

SPECIES_GLAMEOW.name: Glameow
SPECIES_GLAMEOW.description: It is a very fickle Pokémon, which is very popular among some. It claws its Trainer's nose if it isn't fed and purrs when affectionate.

SPECIES_PURUGLY.name: Purugly
SPECIES_PURUGLY.description: It is a brazen brute that barges its way into another Pokémon's nest and claims it as its own. It binds its body with its tails to make itself look bigger.

SPECIES_STUNKY.name: Stunky
SPECIES_STUNKY.description: It protects itself by spraying a nose-curling, stinky fluid from its rear to repel attackers. The stench lingers for 24 hours.

SPECIES_SKUNTANK.name: Skuntank
SPECIES_SKUNTANK.description: It attacks by spraying a horribly smelly fluid from the tip of its tail. The fluid smells worse the longer it is allowed to fester.

SPECIES_BRONZOR.name: Bronzor
SPECIES_BRONZOR.description: Implements shaped like it were discovered in ancient tombs. There are researchers who believe this Pokémon reflected like a mirror in the distant past.

SPECIES_BRONZONG.name: Bronzong
SPECIES_BRONZONG.description: In ages past, this Pokémon was revered as a bringer of rain. One caused a news stir when it was dug up at a construction site after a 2000-year sleep.

SPECIES_CHATOT.name: Chatot
SPECIES_CHATOT.description: It mimics the cries of other Pokémon to trick them into thinking it's one of them. This way they won't attack it. It can also learn and speak human words.

SPECIES_SPIRITOMB.name: Spiritomb
SPECIES_SPIRITOMB.description: A Pokémon that was formed by 108 spirits. Its constant mischief and misdeeds resulted in it being bound to an Odd Keystone by a mysterious spell.

SPECIES_GIBLE.name: Gible
SPECIES_GIBLE.description: It nests in horizontal holes warmed by geothermal heat. Foes who stray too close can expect to be pounced on and bitten.

SPECIES_GABITE.name: Gabite
SPECIES_GABITE.description: Shiny objects are its passion. It can be found in its cave, scarcely moving, its gaze fixed on the jewels it's amassed or Carbink it has caught.

SPECIES_GARCHOMP.name: Garchomp
SPECIES_GARCHOMP.description: When it folds up its body and extends its wings, it looks like a jet plane. It is covered in fine scales that reduce drag, enabling it to fly at high speeds.

SPECIES_GARCHOMP_MEGA.name: Garchomp
SPECIES_GARCHOMP_MEGA.description: Excess energy melted its arms and wings into giant scythes, sending it mad with rage. It swings its scythes wildly and slices the ground to pieces.

SPECIES_RIOLU.name: Riolu
SPECIES_RIOLU.description: It can discern the physical and emotional states of people, Pokémon, and other natural things from the shape of their aura waves.

SPECIES_LUCARIO.name: Lucario
SPECIES_LUCARIO.description: It understands human speech. It is said that no foe can remain invisible to Lucario, since it can detect Auras. Even foes it could not otherwise see.

SPECIES_LUCARIO_MEGA.name: Lucario
SPECIES_LUCARIO_MEGA.description: It readies itself to face its enemies by focusing its mental energies. Its fighting style can be summed up in a single word: heartless.

SPECIES_HIPPOPOTAS.name: Hippopotas
SPECIES_HIPPOPOTAS.description: Hippopotas shuts its nostrils tight when travelling through sand. Instead of perspiration, it expels grains of sand from its body.

SPECIES_HIPPOWDON.name: Hippowdon
SPECIES_HIPPOWDON.description: It is surprisingly quick to anger. It brandishes its gaping mouth in a display of fearsome strength and raises vast quantities of sand while attacking.

SPECIES_SKORUPI.name: Skorupi
SPECIES_SKORUPI.description: It grips prey with its tail claws and injects poison. It tenaciously hangs on until the poison takes. It can survive a year without food.

SPECIES_DRAPION.name: Drapion
SPECIES_DRAPION.description: Possessing a sturdy build, it takes pride in its strength. It has the power in its clawed arms to make scrap out of a car.

SPECIES_CROAGUNK.name: Croagunk
SPECIES_CROAGUNK.description: Croagunk rarely fights fairly. Inflating its poison sacs, it fills the area with an odd sound and hits flinching opponents with a poison jab.

SPECIES_TOXICROAK.name: Toxicroak
SPECIES_TOXICROAK.description: Swaying and dodging the attacks of its foes, it weaves its flexible body in close, then lunges out with its poisonous claws.

SPECIES_CARNIVINE.name: Carnivine
SPECIES_CARNIVINE.description: Hanging from branches using its tentacles, it looks like a plant. It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling saliva, then chomps down.

SPECIES_FINNEON.name: Finneon
SPECIES_FINNEON.description: Its double tail fins propel its energetic jumps. When it breaks the surface of the sea, Wingull swoop down to grab it on the fly.

SPECIES_LUMINEON.name: Lumineon
SPECIES_LUMINEON.description: Lumineon swimming in the darkness of the deep sea look like stars shining in the night sky. It competes for food with Lanturn.

SPECIES_SNOVER.name: Snover
SPECIES_SNOVER.description: During cold seasons, it migrates to the mountain's lower reaches. Seemingly curious about people, they gather around footsteps they find on snowy mountains.

locations.map: Shoal Cave Low Tide Ice Room

SPECIES_ABOMASNOW.name: Abomasnow
SPECIES_ABOMASNOW.description: It lives a quiet life on mountains that are perpetually covered in snow. It hides itself by whipping up blizzards. It is also known as “The Ice Monster.”

SPECIES_ABOMASNOW_MEGA.name: Abomasnow
SPECIES_ABOMASNOW_MEGA.description: The sprouts on Abomasnow's back grow into great shafts of ice when it Mega Evolves. Dislikes associating with others and chooses to live quietly deep in mountains.

SPECIES_ROTOM.name: Rotom
SPECIES_ROTOM.description: Its body is composed of plasma and loves to surprise others. One boy's invention led to the development of many machines that can use of Rotom's unique capabilities.

SPECIES_ROTOM_HEAT.name: Rotom
SPECIES_ROTOM_HEAT.description: If the convection microwave oven is not working properly, then the Rotom inhabiting it will become lethargic. It makes mischief by turning up the heat.

SPECIES_ROTOM_WASH.name: Rotom
SPECIES_ROTOM_WASH.description: It enjoys coming up with water-based pranks. The model of washing machine that Rotom can inspirit has been discontinued, so they are now traded at high prices.

SPECIES_ROTOM_FROST.name: Rotom
SPECIES_ROTOM_FROST.description: In this form, Rotom likes to play freezing cold pranks. You may find it's turned the bath you just filled to solid ice! It battles by spewing cold air.

SPECIES_ROTOM_FAN.name: Rotom
SPECIES_ROTOM_FAN.description: The first appliance developed that Rotom coud inspirit was the electric fan. It uses its power over wind in its pranks, happily blowing any important documents it finds.

SPECIES_ROTOM_MOW.name: Rotom
SPECIES_ROTOM_MOW.description: The lawn mower is an appliance that led to the development of the Rotom Dex. It will mow down grass and flowers, then swagger around with pride at its accomplishments.

SPECIES_UXIE.name: Uxie
SPECIES_UXIE.description: Known as ”The Being of Knowledge,” according to some sources, this Pokémon provided people with the intelligence necessary to solve various problems.

SPECIES_MESPRIT.name: Mesprit
SPECIES_MESPRIT.description: Although it slumbers at the bottom of a lake, its spirit is said to leave its body and flitter on the water surface. It taught humans of sorrow, pain, and joy.

SPECIES_AZELF.name: Azelf
SPECIES_AZELF.description: This Pokémon is said to have endowed humans with the determination needed to do things. It is thought that Uxie, Mesprit and Azelf all came from the same egg.

SPECIES_DIALGA.name: Dialga
SPECIES_DIALGA.description: A Pokémon spoken of in legend. It completely controls the flow of time. It uses its power to travel at will through the past and future.

SPECIES_DIALGA_ORIGIN.name: Dialga
SPECIES_DIALGA_ORIGIN.description: Radiant light caused Dialga to take on a form bearing a striking resemblance to the creator Pokémon. It wields such a colossal strength that this might be its true form.

SPECIES_PALKIA.name: Palkia
SPECIES_PALKIA.description: Palkia has the ability to distort space. Its total control over the boundaries of space enable it to transport itself to faraway places and other dimensions.

SPECIES_PALKIA_ORIGIN.name: Palkia
SPECIES_PALKIA_ORIGIN.description: It soars across the sky in a form that resembles the creator of all things. Perhaps this imitation of appearance is a strategy for gaining Arceus's powers.

SPECIES_HEATRAN.name: Heatran
SPECIES_HEATRAN.description: Boiling blood, like magma, circulates through its body. It dwells in volcanic caves, using its cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.

SPECIES_REGIGIGAS.name: Regigigas
SPECIES_REGIGIGAS.description: There is an enduring legend that states this Pokémon shaped Regirock, Regice, and Registeel out of clay, ice, and magma.

SPECIES_GIRATINA_ALTERED.name: Giratina
SPECIES_GIRATINA_ALTERED.description: This Pokémon is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours, where common knowledge is distorted and strange. It was banished for its violence.

SPECIES_GIRATINA_ORIGIN.name: Giratina
SPECIES_GIRATINA_ORIGIN.description: Giratina loses its legs upon changing into this form. It's believed it hails from a world where the heavens and the earth are as one.

SPECIES_CRESSELIA.name: Cresselia
SPECIES_CRESSELIA.description: Those who sleep holding one of Cresselia's feathers are assured of joyful dreams. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

SPECIES_PHIONE.name: Phione
SPECIES_PHIONE.description: When the water warms, they inflate the flotation sac on their heads and drift languidly on the sea in packs. It always returns to where it was born.

SPECIES_MANAPHY.name: Manaphy
SPECIES_MANAPHY.description: Water makes up 80% of its body. It starts its life with a wondrous power that permits it to bond with any kind of Pokémon.

SPECIES_DARKRAI.name: Darkrai
SPECIES_DARKRAI.description: It chases people and Pokémon from its territory by causing them to experience deep, nightmarish slumbers. However, it means no harm.

SPECIES_SHAYMIN_LAND.name: Shaymin
SPECIES_SHAYMIN_LAND.description: The flowers all over its body bloom if it is lovingly hugged and senses gratitude. It dissolves toxins in the air to transform ruined land into a lush field of flowers.

SPECIES_SHAYMIN_SKY.name: Shaymin
SPECIES_SHAYMIN_SKY.description: Upon taking in the scent of a particular rare flower, Shaymin is enveloped in light and its tiny body transforms, confering the power of flight upon it.

SPECIES_VICTINI.name: Victini
SPECIES_VICTINI.description: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

SPECIES_SNIVY.name: Snivy
SPECIES_SNIVY.description: It is very intelligent and calm. Being exposed to lots of sunlight makes its movements swifter. When they are not feeling well, their tails droop.

SPECIES_SERVINE.name: Servine
SPECIES_SERVINE.description: When it gets dirty, its leaves can't be used in photosynthesis, so it always keeps clean. They avoid attacks by sinking into the shadows of thick foliage.

SPECIES_SERPERIOR.name: Serperior
SPECIES_SERPERIOR.description: They raise their heads to intimidate foes, but only give it their all when fighting powerful opponents who are not fazed by the glare from its noble eyes.

SPECIES_SNIVY_LOGI.name: Snivy
SPECIES_SNIVY_LOGI.description: It has quite the hot temper. Though earning its trust can be a challenge, those that do have a loyal partner for life.

SPECIES_SERVINE_LOGI.name: Servine
SPECIES_SERVINE_LOGI.description: As it grows it hones its skills with its tail, honing the unruly flame into a sharp edge. They will push themselves in battle until they master it.

SPECIES_SERPERIOR_LOGI.name: Serperior
SPECIES_SERPERIOR_LOGI.description: With enough experience it now bathes its tail in a searing stream of flame. Wielding it has become second nature, allowing it to fight with speed and grace unmatched.

SPECIES_TEPIG.name: Tepig
SPECIES_TEPIG.description: It loves to eat roasted berries, but sometimes it gets too excited and burns them to a crisp. It blows fire through its nose.

SPECIES_PIGNITE.name: Pignite
SPECIES_PIGNITE.description: The more it eats, the more fuel it has to make the fire in its stomach stronger. When it is angered, the intensity of the flame increases.

SPECIES_EMBOAR.name: Emboar
SPECIES_EMBOAR.description: It is adept at using many different moves. It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.

SPECIES_OSHAWOTT.name: Oshawott
SPECIES_OSHAWOTT.description: The scalchop on its stomach isn't just used for battle, it can be used to break open hard berries as well. It is made from the same element as its claws.

SPECIES_DEWOTT.name: Dewott
SPECIES_DEWOTT.description: Strict training and disclipine leads it to master its flowing double-scalchop technique. Scalchop techniques differ from one Dewott to another.

SPECIES_SAMUROTT.name: Samurott
SPECIES_SAMUROTT.description: One swing of the seamitars attached to its armor can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of them is enough to intimidate most enemies.

SPECIES_SAMUROTT_HISUI.name: Samurott
SPECIES_SAMUROTT_HISUI.description: Hard of heart and deft of blade, this rare form of Samurott is a product of the Pokémon's evolution in the region of Hisui.

SPECIES_PATRAT.name: Patrat
SPECIES_PATRAT.description: Extremely cautious, they take shifts to maintain a constant watch of their nest. Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watch for days.

SPECIES_WATCHOG.name: Watchog
SPECIES_WATCHOG.description: Using luminescent matter, it makes its eyes and body glow and stuns attacking opponents. Keen eyesight lets them see in the dark.

SPECIES_LILLIPUP.name: Lillipup
SPECIES_LILLIPUP.description: It faces strong opponents with great courage. Because it doesn't yelp, it's extremely popular with Trainers who live in apartment buildings.

SPECIES_HERDIER.name: Herdier
SPECIES_HERDIER.description: Its dense black fur grows continuously. The high cost of keeping its hard fur properly groomed makes this a troublesome Pokémon to train.

SPECIES_STOUTLAND.name: Stoutland
SPECIES_STOUTLAND.description: Intelligent, good-natured, and valiant, there could be no concern that it would ever attack people. Some parents even trust it to babysit.

SPECIES_PURRLOIN.name: Purrloin
SPECIES_PURRLOIN.description: Their deceptively cute act is the perfect ruse. They steal from people for fun, but their victims can't help but forgive them.

SPECIES_LIEPARD.name: Liepard
SPECIES_LIEPARD.description: Many Trainers are drawn to their beautiful form and fur. These Pokémon vanish and appear unexpectedly. They run silently in the night.

SPECIES_PURRLOIN_LOGI.name: Purrloin
SPECIES_PURRLOIN_LOGI.description: Though cute and playful, one nick from its venomous claws can leave you unwell for weeks. Liepard have to teach it control and restraint.

SPECIES_LIEPARD_LOGI.name: Liepard
SPECIES_LIEPARD_LOGI.description: It uses its vitrolic poison to take down foes it cant overpower. Despite how ruthless it can be in the wild, it loves to play.

SPECIES_PANSAGE.name: Pansage
SPECIES_PANSAGE.description: This Pokémon dwells deep in the forest. It's good at finding berries and gathers them from all over. It's kind enough to share them with friends.

SPECIES_SIMISAGE.name: Simisage
SPECIES_SIMISAGE.description: Ill tempered, it attacks enemies by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.

SPECIES_PANSEAR.name: Pansear
SPECIES_PANSEAR.description: The fire within the tuft on its head can reach up to 600ºF. Very intelligent, it roasts berries before eating them. It likes to help people.

SPECIES_SIMISEAR.name: Simisear
SPECIES_SIMISEAR.description: It loves sweets because they become energy for the fire burning inside its body. It scatters embers from its head and tail to sear its opponents.

SPECIES_PANPOUR.name: Panpour
SPECIES_PANPOUR.description: The water stored inside the tuft of its head is rich in nutrients. It waters plants using its tail, plants that receive its water grow large.

SPECIES_SIMIPOUR.name: Simipour
SPECIES_SIMIPOUR.description: It can shoot highly-pressurised water from its tail with enough power to break through a solid concrete wall. It prefers places with clean water.

SPECIES_MUNNA.name: Munna
SPECIES_MUNNA.description: This Pokémon appears before people and Pokémon who are having nightmares and eats those dreams. Munna always float in the air.

SPECIES_MUSHARNA.name: Musharna
SPECIES_MUSHARNA.description: The mist emanating from their foreheads is packed with the dreams of people and Pokémon. It changes into different colors depending on the dream that was eaten.

SPECIES_PIDOVE.name: Pidove
SPECIES_PIDOVE.description: This very forgetful Pokémon will wait for a new order from its Trainer even though it already has one. Flocks often gather in parks and plazas.

SPECIES_TRANQUILL.name: Tranquill
SPECIES_TRANQUILL.description: No matter where in the world it goes, it knows where its nest is, so it can always return to its Trainer's location regardless of the distance.

SPECIES_UNFEZANT.name: Unfezant
SPECIES_UNFEZANT.description: Males have plumage on their heads. The females' flying abilities surpass those of the males. They will only let themselves feel close to their Trainers.

SPECIES_BLITZLE.name: Blitzle
SPECIES_BLITZLE.description: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate with one another.

SPECIES_ZEBSTRIKA.name: Zebstrika
SPECIES_ZEBSTRIKA.description: When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates. It is dangerous when it's angry as it shoots lightning from its mane in all directions.

SPECIES_ROGGENROLA.name: Roggenrola
SPECIES_ROGGENROLA.description: The hexagonal cavity is its ear. It walks in the direction of sounds it hears, but if the sounds cease, it panics and topples over.

SPECIES_BOLDORE.name: Boldore
SPECIES_BOLDORE.description: Its orange crystal is a mass of energy. Just one crystal fragment would provide enough fuel for a hundred dump trucks. When it is healthy, its core sticks out.

SPECIES_GIGALITH.name: Gigalith
SPECIES_GIGALITH.description: The blasts of energy it makes from sunbeams have terrifying power. However, it's not able to fire its blasts at night or on rainy days.

SPECIES_WOOBAT.name: Woobat
SPECIES_WOOBAT.description: Its habitat is dark forests and caves. Suction from its nostrils enables it to stick to cave walls during sleep. It leaves a heart-shaped mark behind.

SPECIES_SWOOBAT.name: Swoobat
SPECIES_SWOOBAT.description: Anyone who comes into contact with the ultrasonic waves emitted by a courting male experiences a positive mood shift.

SPECIES_DRILBUR.name: Drilbur
SPECIES_DRILBUR.description: It can dig through the ground at a speed of 30 mph by spinning its body. It could give a car running aboveground a good race.

SPECIES_EXCADRILL.name: Excadrill
SPECIES_EXCADRILL.description: More than 300 feet below the surface, they build mazelike nests. Their activity can be destructive to subway tunnels, but it can also help with construction.

SPECIES_AUDINO.name: Audino
SPECIES_AUDINO.description: Its auditory sense is astounding. Using the feelers on its ears, it can tell how someone is feeling or when an egg might hatch.

SPECIES_AUDINO_MEGA.name: Audino
SPECIES_AUDINO_MEGA.description: Mega Audino emits a soothing pulse from its body that reduces hostility in others. Anything that comes into contact with its second feelers will fall into a deep sleep.

SPECIES_TIMBURR.name: Timburr
SPECIES_TIMBURR.description: These Pokémon appear at building sites and help out with construction. They always carry squared logs. As they grow, they carry bigger logs.

SPECIES_GURDURR.name: Gurdurr
SPECIES_GURDURR.description: They strengthen their bodies by carrying steel beams. This Pokémon is so muscular and strongly built that even a group of wrestlers could not make it budge an inch.

SPECIES_CONKELDURR.name: Conkeldurr
SPECIES_CONKELDURR.description: They use concrete pillars as walking canes. Rather than rely solely on force, they master moves that utilize the centrifugal force of spinning concrete.

SPECIES_TYMPOLE.name: Tympole
SPECIES_TYMPOLE.description: By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans. It uses the rhythm of these sounds to talk and warns others of danger.

SPECIES_PALPITOAD.name: Palpitoad
SPECIES_PALPITOAD.description: It lives in the water and on land. When they vibrate the bumps on their heads, they can make waves in water or earthquake-like vibrations on land.

SPECIES_SEISMITOAD.name: Seismitoad
SPECIES_SEISMITOAD.description: It increases the power of its punches by vibrating the bumps on its fists. They can also shoot paralyzing liquid from their head bumps.

SPECIES_THROH.name: Throh
SPECIES_THROH.description: When it tightens its belt, it becomes stronger. Wild Throh use vines to weave their own belts. It changes belts as it gets more powerful.

SPECIES_SAWK.name: Sawk
SPECIES_SAWK.description: The sound of Sawk punching boulders and trees can be heard all the way from the mountains where they train. Disturbing their training angers them.

SPECIES_SEWADDLE.name: Sewaddle
SPECIES_SEWADDLE.description: It chews up leaves and sews them with sticky thread extruded from its mouth. Since this Pokémon makes its own clothes, it is a mascot for fashion designers.

SPECIES_SWADLOON.name: Swadloon
SPECIES_SWADLOON.description: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.

SPECIES_LEAVANNY.name: Leavanny
SPECIES_LEAVANNY.description: It keeps its eggs warm with heat from fermenting leaves. It also uses leaves to weave warm wrappings for Sewaddle by using the silk secreted from its mouth.

SPECIES_VENIPEDE.name: Venipede
SPECIES_VENIPEDE.description: Using the feelers on its head and tail, it picks up vibrations in the air to determine its prey's location and state. It is brutally aggressive.

SPECIES_WHIRLIPEDE.name: Whirlipede
SPECIES_WHIRLIPEDE.description: Storing energy for evolution, it sits. But when attacked, it spins its body at high speed like a wheel and then crashes furiously into its opponent.

SPECIES_SCOLIPEDE.name: Scolipede
SPECIES_SCOLIPEDE.description: With quick movements, it chases down its foes, attacking relentlessly with its horns until it prevails. Then it finishes them off with deadly poison.

SPECIES_COTTONEE.name: Cottonee
SPECIES_COTTONEE.description: When it finds others of its kind, they all stick together. When enough of them have collected, the mass resembles a cumulonimbus cloud.

SPECIES_WHIMSICOTT.name: Whimsicott
SPECIES_WHIMSICOTT.description: It rides on the wind and slips into people's homes. After it has turned a room into a cotton-filled mess, it giggles to itself and takes off.

SPECIES_WHIMSICOTT_MEGA.name: Whimsicott
SPECIES_WHIMSICOTT_MEGA.description: Its fluffiness gets out of control with Mega Evolution. This is seemingly to protect its latent energy, until sunlight where extreme power blooms.

SPECIES_WHIMSICOTT_MEGA_SUNSHINE.name: Whimsicott
SPECIES_WHIMSICOTT_MEGA_SUNSHINE.description: Its fluffiness gets out of control with Mega Evolution. This is seemingly to protect its latent energy, until sunlight where extreme power blooms.

SPECIES_PETILIL.name: Petilil
SPECIES_PETILIL.description: By pruning the leaves on its head with regularity, this Pokémon can be grown into a fine plump shape. These bitter leaves refresh those who eat them.

SPECIES_LILLIGANT.name: Lilligant
SPECIES_LILLIGANT.description: Even veteran Trainers face a challenge in getting its beautiful flower to bloom. It withers away if a trainer does not take good care of it.

SPECIES_LILLIGANT_HISUI.name: Lilligant
SPECIES_LILLIGANT_HISUI.description: Its well-developed legs are the result of a life spent on mountains covered in deep snow. The scent it exudes from its flower crown heartens those in proximity.

SPECIES_BASCULIN_RED_STRIPED.name: Basculin
SPECIES_BASCULIN_RED_STRIPED.description: It used to be a common food source. The meat of red Basculin is on the fatty side and it's more popular with the youth. Its temperament is vicious and aggressive.

SPECIES_BASCULIN_BLUE_STRIPED.name: Basculin
SPECIES_BASCULIN_BLUE_STRIPED.description: They form schools with others of the same color. The greatest foe of a school of blue Basculin is a school of red Basculin. Its flavor is light and inoffensive.

SPECIES_BASCULIN_WHITE_STRIPED.name: Basculin
SPECIES_BASCULIN_WHITE_STRIPED.description: While this ancient form of Basculin shares a vast array of qualities with other forms, it differs in several respects, including demeanor, being much gentler than others.

SPECIES_BASCULEGION_M.name: Basculegion
SPECIES_BASCULEGION_M.description: Clads itself in the souls of comrades that perished before fulfilling their goals of journeying upstream. No other species in all Hisui's rivers is Basculegion's equal.

SPECIES_BASCULEGION_F.name: Basculegion
SPECIES_BASCULEGION_F.description: The souls of its comrades cloak its body and propel it effortlessly through even raging rapids.

SPECIES_SANDILE.name: Sandile
SPECIES_SANDILE.description: It conceals itself in the sand and chomps down on the legs of any prey that unwarily walk over it. Its favorite food is Trapinch.

SPECIES_KROKOROK.name: Krokorok
SPECIES_KROKOROK.description: They move in groups of a few individuals. Thanks to the special membrane covering its eyes, it can see its surroundings clearly, even in the dead of night.

SPECIES_KROOKODILE.name: Krookodile
SPECIES_KROOKODILE.description: Very violent Pokémon, they never allow their prey to escape. Their jaws are so powerful, they can crush the body of an automobile.

SPECIES_DARUMAKA.name: Darumaka
SPECIES_DARUMAKA.description: When its internal fire is burning, it cannot calm down and it runs around. When the fire diminishes, it pulls its limbs into its body and falls asleep.

SPECIES_DARMANITAN_STANDARD.name: Darmanitan
SPECIES_DARMANITAN_STANDARD.description: When one is injured in a fierce battle, it transforms into a stone statue. Then it meditates and sharpens its mind and fights on mentally.

SPECIES_DARMANITAN_ZEN.name: Darmanitan
SPECIES_DARMANITAN_ZEN.description: When wounded, it stops moving. It goes as still as stone to meditate, sharpening its mind and spirit.

SPECIES_DARUMAKA_GALAR.name: Darumaka
SPECIES_DARUMAKA_GALAR.description: The colder they get, the more energetic they are. They freeze their breath to make snowballs, using them as ammo for playful snowball fights.

SPECIES_DARMANITAN_GALAR_STANDARD.name: Darmanitan
SPECIES_DARMANITAN_GALAR_STANDARD.description: On days when blizzards blow through, it comes down to where people live. It stashes food in the snowball on its head, taking it home for later.

SPECIES_DARMANITAN_GALAR_ZEN.name: Darmanitan
SPECIES_DARMANITAN_GALAR_ZEN.description: Darmanitan takes this form when enraged. It won't stop spewing flames until its rage has settled, even if its body starts to melt.

SPECIES_MARACTUS.name: Maractus
SPECIES_MARACTUS.description: Arid regions are their habitat. When it moves rhythmically, it makes a sound similar to maracas, making the surprised Pokémon flee.

SPECIES_DWEBBLE.name: Dwebble
SPECIES_DWEBBLE.description: It makes a hole in a stone of a suitable size. If that rock breaks, the Pokémon remains agitated until it locates a replacement.

SPECIES_CRUSTLE.name: Crustle
SPECIES_CRUSTLE.description: Competing for territory, Crustle fight viciously. The one whose boulder is broken is the loser of the battle and begins to weaken.

SPECIES_SCRAGGY.name: Scraggy
SPECIES_SCRAGGY.description: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck. Its skull is massively thick.

SPECIES_SCRAFTY.name: Scrafty
SPECIES_SCRAFTY.description: Groups of them beat up anything that enters their territory. The one with the biggest crest is the group leader, and is the most respected.

SPECIES_SIGILYPH.name: Sigilyph
SPECIES_SIGILYPH.description: The guardians of an ancient city, they always fly the same route while keeping watch for invaders. They use their psychic power to attack enemies.

SPECIES_YAMASK.name: Yamask
SPECIES_YAMASK.description: These Pokémon arose from the spirits of people interred in graves in past ages. Each of them carries a mask that used to be its face when it was human.

SPECIES_COFAGRIGUS.name: Cofagrigus
SPECIES_COFAGRIGUS.description: Grave robbers who mistake them for real coffins and get too close end up trapped inside their bodies. Their bodies are covered in pure gold.

SPECIES_YAMASK_GALAR.name: Yamask
SPECIES_YAMASK_GALAR.description: A clay slab with cursed engravings took possession of a Yamask. The slab is said to be absorbing the Yamask's dark power.

SPECIES_RUNERIGUS.name: Runerigus
SPECIES_RUNERIGUS.description: A powerful curse was woven into an ancient painting. After absorbing the spirit of a Yamask, the painting began to move.

SPECIES_TIRTOUGA.name: Tirtouga
SPECIES_TIRTOUGA.description: Reputed to be the ancestor of most turtle Pokémon, it lived in warm seas about a hundred million years ago. It was restored from a fossil.

SPECIES_CARRACOSTA.name: Carracosta
SPECIES_CARRACOSTA.description: They can live both in the ocean and on land. Incredible jaw strength enables them to chew up steel beams and rocks along with their prey.

SPECIES_ARCHEN.name: Archen
SPECIES_ARCHEN.description: Said to be the ancestor of all bird Pokémon, Archen itself could not actually fly but moved by hopping from treetop to treetop.

SPECIES_ARCHEOPS.name: Archeops
SPECIES_ARCHEOPS.description: They are intelligent and will cooperate to catch prey. When one Archeops had the prey cornered, another would swoop on it.

SPECIES_TRUBBISH.name: Trubbish
SPECIES_TRUBBISH.description: It gorges on trash until its stomach is full. Then it belches toxic gas. An unlucky whiff of this gas will put a person in the hospital.

SPECIES_GARBODOR.name: Garbodor
SPECIES_GARBODOR.description: Beware the poisonous liquid it shoots from its right arm. If even a little of it gets on you, you'll experience the full effects of this unidentified toxin.

SPECIES_GARBODOR_GMAX.name: Garbodor
SPECIES_GARBODOR_GMAX.description: It sprays toxic gas from its mouth and fingers. If the gas engulfs you, the toxins will seep in all the way down to your bones.

SPECIES_ZORUA.name: Zorua
SPECIES_ZORUA.description: To protect themselves from danger, they hide their true identities by transforming into people and Pokémon. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.

SPECIES_ZOROARK.name: Zoroark
SPECIES_ZOROARK.description: Bonds between these Pokémon are very strong. It protects the safety of its pack by tricking its opponents. They defend their lair with illusory scenery.

SPECIES_ZORUA_HISUI.name: Zorua
SPECIES_ZORUA_HISUI.description: Derives power from resentment, which rises as energy atop its head and takes on the forms of foes. In this way, Zorua vents lingering malice.

SPECIES_ZOROARK_HISUI.name: Zoroark
SPECIES_ZOROARK_HISUI.description: Heedless of its own safety, Zoroark attacks its nemeses with a bitter energy so intense, it lacerates Zoroark's own body.

SPECIES_MINCCINO.name: Minccino
SPECIES_MINCCINO.description: These Pokémon prefer a tidy habitat. They greet one another by rubbing each other with their tails, which are always kept well groomed and clean.

SPECIES_CINCCINO.name: Cinccino
SPECIES_CINCCINO.description: Their white fur feels amazing to touch. Cinccino's body is coated in a special oil that repels dust and helps it deflect attacks, such as punches.

SPECIES_GOTHITA.name: Gothita
SPECIES_GOTHITA.description: They intently observe both Trainers and Pokémon. Apparently, Gothita are looking at something that only they can see. Their ribbonlike feelers increase their power.

SPECIES_GOTHORITA.name: Gothorita
SPECIES_GOTHORITA.description: Starlight is the source of their power. They use hypnosis to control people and Pokémon. Tales of Gothorita leading them astray are told in every corner.

SPECIES_GOTHITELLE.name: Gothitelle
SPECIES_GOTHITELLE.description: Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their intense psychic power. When it learns its Trainer's life span, it cries in sadness.

SPECIES_SOLOSIS.name: Solosis
SPECIES_SOLOSIS.description: Because their bodies are enveloped in a special liquid, they are fine in any environment, no matter how severe. They can use telepathy to talk with others.

SPECIES_DUOSION.name: Duosion
SPECIES_DUOSION.description: When their brains, now divided in two, are thinking the same thoughts, these Pokémon exhibit their maximized psychic power.

SPECIES_REUNICLUS.name: Reuniclus
SPECIES_REUNICLUS.description: They use psychic power to control their arms, which are made of a special liquid. When Reuniclus shake hands, a network forms between their brains.

SPECIES_DUCKLETT.name: Ducklett
SPECIES_DUCKLETT.description: These bird Pokémon are excellent divers. They are better at swimming than flying, and they happily eat their favorite food, peat moss, as they dive underwater.

SPECIES_SWANNA.name: Swanna
SPECIES_SWANNA.description: Despite their elegant appearance, they can flap their wings strongly and fly for thousands of miles. The one in the middle is the leader of the flock.

SPECIES_VANILLITE.name: Vanillite
SPECIES_VANILLITE.description: The temperature of their breath is -58ºF. They create snow crystals and make snow fall in the areas around them. Vanillite is treasured by households in warm regions.

SPECIES_VANILLISH.name: Vanillish
SPECIES_VANILLISH.description: Vanillish has existed since the Ice Age. It controls particles of ice, freezes its opponents, and then shatters them with a headbutt.

SPECIES_VANILLUXE.name: Vanilluxe
SPECIES_VANILLUXE.description: Each of its two heads has a brain, and when they are in agreement, it attacks its enemies by exhaling a violent blizzard. It makes snow clouds inside its body.

SPECIES_DEERLING_SPRING.name: Deerling
SPECIES_DEERLING_SPRING.description: Deerling have different scents depending on the season. In early spring, these Pokémon give off a delicate, sweet, and calming scent.

SPECIES_DEERLING_SUMMER.name: Deerling
SPECIES_DEERLING_SUMMER.description: To prevent Deerling from entering their fields, many farmers will have several Lycanroc stand guard, as they are its natural enemy.

SPECIES_DEERLING_AUTUMN.name: Deerling
SPECIES_DEERLING_AUTUMN.description: Deerling have different scents depending on the season. In this form, Deerling have a softly sweet scent that lingers in the nose.

SPECIES_DEERLING_WINTER.name: Deerling
SPECIES_DEERLING_WINTER.description: Deerling's scent changes with the seasons, but when the Pokémon is in its Winter Form, it has hardly any scent at all.

SPECIES_SAWSBUCK_SPRING.name: Sawsbuck
SPECIES_SAWSBUCK_SPRING.description: Some people call Sawsbuck the harbingers of spring because the plants growing on its horns change according to the season. The leader possesses magnificent horns.

SPECIES_SAWSBUCK_SUMMER.name: Sawsbuck
SPECIES_SAWSBUCK_SUMMER.description: The thicker and larger the branches and leaves on its antlers, the more majestic the Sawsbuck is thought to be.

SPECIES_SAWSBUCK_AUTUMN.name: Sawsbuck
SPECIES_SAWSBUCK_AUTUMN.description: Sawsbuck in their Autumn Form are known for having very short tempers. The males fight each other incessantly.

SPECIES_SAWSBUCK_WINTER.name: Sawsbuck
SPECIES_SAWSBUCK_WINTER.description: Though there are many enthusiasts for Sawsbuck as a species, this seasonal form in particular is not very popular.

SPECIES_EMOLGA.name: Emolga
SPECIES_EMOLGA.description: It glides using its cape-like membrane. It grills berries and bug Pokémon with electric shocks from the pouches on its cheeks and makes a meal of them.

SPECIES_KARRABLAST.name: Karrablast
SPECIES_KARRABLAST.description: When they feel threatened, they spit an acidic liquid to drive attackers away. For some reason they evolve while they are in the same place as Shelmet.

SPECIES_ESCAVALIER.name: Escavalier
SPECIES_ESCAVALIER.description: Wearing the shell covering they stole from Shelmet, they defend themselves and attack with two lances. The steel armor protects their whole body.

SPECIES_FOONGUS.name: Foongus
SPECIES_FOONGUS.description: It lures Pokémon in with its pattern that looks just like a Poké Ball, then releases its poison spores. Why it resembles a Poké Ball is unknown.

SPECIES_AMOONGUSS.name: Amoonguss
SPECIES_AMOONGUSS.description: It lures prey close by dancing and waving its arm caps, which resemble Poké Balls, in a swaying motion, but very few Pokémon are fooled by this.

SPECIES_FRILLISH.name: Frillish
SPECIES_FRILLISH.description: If its veil-like arms stun and wrap an opponent, that foe will be dragged five miles below the surface to its lair, never to return.

SPECIES_JELLICENT.name: Jellicent
SPECIES_JELLICENT.description: They propel themselves by expelling absorbed seawater from their bodies. It's said there's a castle of ships Jellicent have sunk on the seafloor.

SPECIES_ALOMOMOLA.name: Alomomola
SPECIES_ALOMOMOLA.description: When they find a wounded Pokémon, they embrace it and bring it to shore. The special membrane enveloping Alomomola has the ability to heal wounds.

SPECIES_JOLTIK.name: Joltik
SPECIES_JOLTIK.description: Since they can't generate their own electricity, they attach themselves to large-bodied Pokémon and absorb static electricity, which they store in a pouch.

SPECIES_GALVANTULA.name: Galvantula
SPECIES_GALVANTULA.description: It creates barriers from electrified silk that stun foes. This works as a weapon as well as a defense. While it is immobilized by shock, they leisurely consume it.

SPECIES_FERROSEED.name: Ferroseed
SPECIES_FERROSEED.description: It absorbs the iron it finds in the rock while clinging to the ceiling of caves. When threatened, it attacks by shooting a barrage of spikes.

SPECIES_FERROTHORN.name: Ferrothorn
SPECIES_FERROTHORN.description: It fights by swinging around its three spiky feelers and shooting spikes. A hit from these steel spikes can reduce a boulder to rubble.

SPECIES_KLINK.name: Klink
SPECIES_KLINK.description: Two bodies comprise a fixed pair. The two minigears that mesh together are predetermined. Each will rebound from other minigears without meshing.

SPECIES_KLANG.name: Klang
SPECIES_KLANG.description: A minigear and big gear comprise its body. Spinning minigears are rotated at high speed and repeatedly fired away. It is dangerous if the gears don't return.

SPECIES_KLINKLANG.name: Klinklang
SPECIES_KLINKLANG.description: Its red core functions as an energy tank. It is rotated at high speed for a rapid energy charge. It fires the charged energy through its spikes into an area.

SPECIES_TYNAMO.name: Tynamo
SPECIES_TYNAMO.description: These Pokémon move in schools. One alone can emit only a trickle of electricity, so a group of them gathers to unleash a powerful electric shock.

SPECIES_EELEKTRIK.name: Eelektrik
SPECIES_EELEKTRIK.description: These Pokémon have a big appetite. It wraps itself around its prey and paralyzes it with electricity from the round spots on its sides. Then it chomps.

SPECIES_EELEKTROSS.name: Eelektross
SPECIES_EELEKTROSS.description: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean, with their sucker mouths.

SPECIES_ELGYEM.name: Elgyem
SPECIES_ELGYEM.description: It psychically squeezes the brain of its foe, causing unendurable headaches. Rumors of its origin are linked to a UFO crash site in the desert 50 years ago.

SPECIES_BEHEEYEM.name: Beheeyem
SPECIES_BEHEEYEM.description: It can manipulate an opponent's memory. Apparently, it communicates by flashing its three fingers, but those patterns haven't been decoded.

SPECIES_LITWICK.name: Litwick
SPECIES_LITWICK.description: While Litwick shines a light and pretends to be a guide, it absorbs the life force of any who follow it, which becomes the fuel that it burns.

SPECIES_LAMPENT.name: Lampent
SPECIES_LAMPENT.description: This ominous Pokémon is feared. Through cities it wanders, searching for the spirits of the fallen. The spirits it absorbs fuel its baleful fire.

SPECIES_CHANDELURE.name: Chandelure
SPECIES_CHANDELURE.description: Being consumed in Chandelure's flame burns up the spirit, leaving the body behind. By waving the flames on its arms, it puts its foes into a hypnotic trance.

SPECIES_AXEW.name: Axew
SPECIES_AXEW.description: They mark their territory by leaving gashes in trees with their tusks. If a tusk breaks, a new one grows in quickly, harder and sturdier than the last.

SPECIES_FRAXURE.name: Fraxure
SPECIES_FRAXURE.description: Their tusks can shatter rocks. A broken tusk will not grow back, so it diligently sharpens its tusks on river rocks after the end of a battle.

SPECIES_HAXORUS.name: Haxorus
SPECIES_HAXORUS.description: They are kind but can be relentless when defending territory. Their sturdy tusks will stay sharp even if used to cut steel beams.

SPECIES_HAXORUS_MEGA.name: Haxorus
SPECIES_HAXORUS_MEGA.description: Mega evolution has seen its draconic energy erupt with a dark flame. Contrary to its looks however, it is still noble and kind, but enacts justice without mercy.

SPECIES_CUBCHOO.name: Cubchoo
SPECIES_CUBCHOO.description: Its nose is always running. Their snot is a barometer of health. When healthy, their snot is sticky and the power of their ice moves increases.

SPECIES_BEARTIC.name: Beartic
SPECIES_BEARTIC.description: It freezes its breath to create fangs and claws of ice to fight with. Very able in the water, it swims around in northern seas and catches prey.

SPECIES_CRYOGONAL.name: Cryogonal
SPECIES_CRYOGONAL.description: They are born in snow clouds. When its body temperature goes up, it turns into steam and vanishes. When its temperature lowers, it returns to ice.

SPECIES_SHELMET.name: Shelmet
SPECIES_SHELMET.description: When attacked, it defends itself by closing the lid of its shell. It evolves when bathed in an electric-like energy along with Karrablast.

SPECIES_ACCELGOR.name: Accelgor
SPECIES_ACCELGOR.description: When its body dries out, it weakens. So, to prevent dehydration, it wraps itself in layers of thin membrane. It is very light and fights with ninja-like movements.

SPECIES_STUNFISK.name: Stunfisk
SPECIES_STUNFISK.description: It conceals itself in the mud of the seashore. Then it waits. When prey touch it, it delivers a jolt of electricity. It smiles when transmitting electricity.

SPECIES_STUNFISK_GALAR.name: Stunfisk
SPECIES_STUNFISK_GALAR.description: Its conspicuous lips lure prey in as it lies in wait in the mud. When prey gets close, Stunfisk clamps its jagged steel fins down on them.

SPECIES_MIENFOO.name: Mienfoo
SPECIES_MIENFOO.description: They have mastered elegant combos. As they concentrate, their battle moves become swifter and more precise. What it lacks in power, it makes up for in quantity.

SPECIES_MIENSHAO.name: Mienshao
SPECIES_MIENSHAO.description: They use the long fur on their arms as a whip to strike their opponents. Its arm attacks come with such rapidity that they cannot even be seen.

SPECIES_DRUDDIGON.name: Druddigon
SPECIES_DRUDDIGON.description: It warms its body by absorbing sunlight with its wings. When its body temperature falls, it can no longer move. It uses its sharp claws to catch prey.

SPECIES_GOLETT.name: Golett
SPECIES_GOLETT.description: These Pokémon are thought to have been created by the science of an ancient and mysterious civilization. It's been active for thousands of years.

SPECIES_GOLURK.name: Golurk
SPECIES_GOLURK.description: Golurk were created to protect people and Pokémon by an ancient civilisation. Removing the seal on its chest makes its internal energy go out of control.

SPECIES_PAWNIARD.name: Pawniard
SPECIES_PAWNIARD.description: Ignoring their injuries, groups attack by sinking the blades that cover their bodies into their prey. If battling dulls them, it sharpens them on stones by the river.

SPECIES_BISHARP.name: Bisharp
SPECIES_BISHARP.description: This pitiless Pokémon commands a group of Pawniard to hound prey into immobility. It battles to become the boss, but will be driven from the group if it loses.

SPECIES_KINGAMBIT.name: Kingambit
SPECIES_KINGAMBIT.description: Though it commands a massive army in battle, it's not skilled at devising complex strategies. It just uses brute strength to keep pushing.

SPECIES_BOUFFALANT.name: Bouffalant
SPECIES_BOUFFALANT.description: Their fluffy fur absorbs damage, even if they strike foes with a fierce headbutt. Their headbutts have enough destructive force to derail a train.

SPECIES_RUFFLET.name: Rufflet
SPECIES_RUFFLET.description: With its sharp claws, this Pokémon pierces its prey, and then it pecks at them. Although it also consumes berries, it's a carnivore at heart.

SPECIES_BRAVIARY.name: Braviary
SPECIES_BRAVIARY.description: For the sake of its friends, this brave warrior of the sky will not stop battling, even if it is injured. One can carry a car while flying.

SPECIES_BRAVIARY_HISUI.name: Braviary
SPECIES_BRAVIARY_HISUI.description: Screaming a bloodcurdling battle cry, this huge and ferocious bird Pokémon goes out on the hunt.

SPECIES_VULLABY.name: Vullaby
SPECIES_VULLABY.description: It can't fly yet and must wait until its wings have developed more. They guard their posteriors with bones that were gathered by Mandibuzz.

SPECIES_MANDIBUZZ.name: Mandibuzz
SPECIES_MANDIBUZZ.description: They adorn themselves beautifully with bones. This is supposedly an effort to attract males, but no male Mandibuzz have ever been found.

SPECIES_HEATMOR.name: Heatmor
SPECIES_HEATMOR.description: It draws in air through its tail, transforms it into fire, and uses it like a tongue. They burn through Durant's steel bodies and consume their insides.

SPECIES_DURANT.name: Durant
SPECIES_DURANT.description: Durant dig nests in mountains. Individuals each play different roles in driving Heatmor, their natural predator, away from their colony.

SPECIES_DURANT_LOGI.name: Durant
SPECIES_DURANT_LOGI.description: Almost driven to extinction by Heatmor, Durant adapted. It can leave its casing as pure electrical energy to combine with its colony and overwhelm its foes.

SPECIES_DURANT_LOGI_COLONY.name: Durant
SPECIES_DURANT_LOGI_COLONY.description: This form is the result of a colony of Durant coming together as a hivemind of devastating electrical energy. It no longer fears Heatmor.

SPECIES_DEINO.name: Deino
SPECIES_DEINO.description: Lacking sight, it's unaware of its surroundings, so it bumps into things and eats anything that moves. Approaching it carelessly is dangerous.

SPECIES_ZWEILOUS.name: Zweilous
SPECIES_ZWEILOUS.description: After it has eaten up all the food in its territory, it moves on to another area. Whichever head eats more than the other gets to be the leader.

SPECIES_HYDREIGON.name: Hydreigon
SPECIES_HYDREIGON.description: This brutal Pokémon travels the skies on its six wings. The heads on their arms do not have brains. They use all three heads to consume and destroy everything.

SPECIES_DEINO_LOGI.name: Deino
SPECIES_DEINO_LOGI.description: Its surprisingly popular as a cute pet in tropical climates, though if left to its own devices it will eat everything and grow to have a ferocious disposition.

SPECIES_ZWEILOUS_LOGI.name: Zweilous
SPECIES_ZWEILOUS_LOGI.description: Its new second head has only one thing on its mind: to eat everything in sight. Its saliva is corrosive enough to break down anything unfortunate enough.

SPECIES_HYDREIGON_LOGI.name: Hydreigon
SPECIES_HYDREIGON_LOGI.description: A Hydreigon that has grown this much can potentially take over an entire ecosystem. Old tales suggest travelers have wandered into jungles that were actually this Pokémon.

SPECIES_LARVESTA.name: Larvesta
SPECIES_LARVESTA.description: This Pokémon was believed to have been born from the sun. It spews fire from its horns and encases itself in a cocoon of fire when it evolves.

SPECIES_COBALION.name: Cobalion
SPECIES_COBALION.description: It has a body and heart of steel. This legendary Pokémon battled against humans to protect Pokémon. Its personality is calm and composed.

SPECIES_TERRAKION.name: Terrakion
SPECIES_TERRAKION.description: Spoken of in legend, this Pokémon used its phenomenal power to destroy a castle in its effort to protect Pokémon that had lost their homes in a war among humans.

locations.map: Shoal Cave Low Tide Stairs Room
Shoal Cave Low Tide Lower Room
Shoal Cave Low Tide Inner Room
Shoal Cave Low Tide Entrance Room

SPECIES_VIRIZION.name: Virizion
SPECIES_VIRIZION.description: Its head sprouts horns as sharp as blades. Legends say this Pokémon used whirlwind-like movements to confound and swiftly cut its opponents.

locations.map: Shoal Cave Low Tide Stairs Room
Shoal Cave Low Tide Lower Room
Shoal Cave Low Tide Inner Room
Shoal Cave Low Tide Entrance Room

SPECIES_TORNADUS_INCARNATE.name: Tornadus
SPECIES_TORNADUS_INCARNATE.description: Tornadus expels massive energy from its tail, causing severe storms. Its power can blow entire houses away. It zooms through the sky at 200 mph.

SPECIES_TORNADUS_THERIAN.name: Tornadus
SPECIES_TORNADUS_THERIAN.description: An example of what is known as a “form change”. Tornadus has been sighted crossing the ocean while in this form.

SPECIES_THUNDURUS_INCARNATE.name: Thundurus
SPECIES_THUNDURUS_INCARNATE.description: The spikes on its tail discharge immense bolts of lightning. Countless charred remains mar the landscape of places through which Thundurus has passed.

SPECIES_THUNDURUS_THERIAN.name: Thundurus
SPECIES_THUNDURUS_THERIAN.description: It pulverizes foes into nothingness with showers of devastatingly powerful lightning bolts launched from the string of orbs on its tail.

SPECIES_RESHIRAM.name: Reshiram
SPECIES_RESHIRAM.description: This Pokémon appears in legends. It sends flames into the air from its tail, burning up everything around it. It helps those who want to build a world of truth.

SPECIES_ZEKROM.name: Zekrom
SPECIES_ZEKROM.description: This legendary Pokémon can scorch the world with lightning. It has a generator that creates electricity in its tail. It assists those with strong ideals.

SPECIES_LANDORUS_INCARNATE.name: Landorus
SPECIES_LANDORUS_INCARNATE.description: The energy that comes pouring from its tail increases the nutrition in the soil, granting bountiful crops. It has been hailed as “The Guardian of the Fields.”

SPECIES_LANDORUS_THERIAN.name: Landorus
SPECIES_LANDORUS_THERIAN.description: Landorus soars through the sky in this form, bestowing plentiful harvests upon the land and earning the people's reverence.

SPECIES_KYUREM.name: Kyurem
SPECIES_KYUREM.description: This legendary ice Pokémon waits for a hero to fill in the missing parts of its body with truth or ideals. Its body became frozen when its energy leaked out.

SPECIES_KYUREM_WHITE.name: Kyurem
SPECIES_KYUREM_WHITE.description: The sameness of Reshiram's and Kyurem's genes allowed Kyurem to absorb Reshiram. Kyurem can now use the power of both fire and ice.

SPECIES_KYUREM_BLACK.name: Kyurem
SPECIES_KYUREM_BLACK.description: The sameness of Zekrom's and Kyurem's genes allowed Kyurem to absorb Zekrom. Kyurem can now use the power of both electricity and ice.

SPECIES_KELDEO_ORDINARY.name: Keldeo
SPECIES_KELDEO_ORDINARY.description: When it is resolute, its body fills with power and it becomes swifter. It crosses the world, running over the surfaces of oceans and rivers.

SPECIES_KELDEO_RESOLUTE.name: Keldeo
SPECIES_KELDEO_RESOLUTE.description: The power that lay hidden in its body now covers its horn, turning it into a sword that can slice through anything.

SPECIES_MELOETTA_ARIA.name: Meloetta
SPECIES_MELOETTA_ARIA.description: The melodies sung by Meloetta have the power to make Pokémon that hear them happy or sad. Many famous songs have been inspired by the tunes that Meloetta plays.

SPECIES_MELOETTA_PIROUETTE.name: Meloetta
SPECIES_MELOETTA_PIROUETTE.description: Meloetta's melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.

SPECIES_CHESPIN.name: Chespin
SPECIES_CHESPIN.description: The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp that they can pierce rock without any effort.

SPECIES_QUILLADIN.name: Quilladin
SPECIES_QUILLADIN.description: They strengthen the sturdy shell covering their bodies by running into one another. They are very kind and won't start fights, but will counterattack with sharp quills.

SPECIES_CHESNAUGHT.name: Chesnaught
SPECIES_CHESNAUGHT.description: It shields its allies from danger with its own body. When it takes a defensive posture with its fists guarding its face, it can withstand a bomb blast.

SPECIES_FENNEKIN.name: Fennekin
SPECIES_FENNEKIN.description: As it walks, it munches on a twig to fill itself with energy in place of a snack. It intimidates opponents by puffing hot air out of its roomy ears.

SPECIES_BRAIXEN.name: Braixen
SPECIES_BRAIXEN.description: Braixen has a twig stuck in its tail. When the twig is plucked from its tail, friction sets the twig alight. The flame is used to send signals to its allies.

SPECIES_DELPHOX.name: Delphox
SPECIES_DELPHOX.description: It gazes into the flame at the tip of its branch to achieve a focused state, which allows it to see into the future. It uses psychic power to incinerate its foes.

SPECIES_FROAKIE.name: Froakie
SPECIES_FROAKIE.description: It protects its skin by covering its body in bubbles it secretes from its chest and back. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.

SPECIES_FROGADIER.name: Frogadier
SPECIES_FROGADIER.description: It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with precise control, hitting empty cans up to a hundred feet away. Frogadier's swiftness is unparalleled.

SPECIES_BUNNELBY.name: Bunnelby
SPECIES_BUNNELBY.description: It has ears like shovels. Digging holes strengthens its ears so much that they can sever thick roots effortlessly. Bunnelby dig the whole night through.

SPECIES_DIGGERSBY.name: Diggersby
SPECIES_DIGGERSBY.description: With its powerful ears it reduces dense bedrock to rubble. It can be a big help at construction sites. When it's finished digging, it lounges about lazily.

SPECIES_FLETCHLING.name: Fletchling
SPECIES_FLETCHLING.description: This amiable Pokémon is easy to train. But when battle is joined, it shows its ferocious side. It's merciless to intruders that enter its territory.

SPECIES_FLETCHINDER.name: Fletchinder
SPECIES_FLETCHINDER.description: From its beak, it expels embers that set the tall grass on fire. Then it pounces on any bewildered Pokémon that pop out of the grass.

SPECIES_TALONFLAME.name: Talonflame
SPECIES_TALONFLAME.description: In the fever of an exciting battle, it showers embers from the gaps between its feathers and takes to the air. It finishes its prey off with a colossal kick.

SPECIES_LITLEO.name: Litleo
SPECIES_LITLEO.description: They set off on their own from their pride and live by themselves to become stronger. These hot-blooded Pokémon are quick to start a fight.

SPECIES_PYROAR.name: Pyroar
SPECIES_PYROAR.description: The male with the largest mane of fire is the leader of the pride. The females protect the pride's cubs. They viciously threaten any challenger.

SPECIES_FLOETTE_ETERNAL.name: Floette Eternal
SPECIES_FLOETTE_ETERNAL.description: The flower it's holding can no longer be found blooming anywhere. It's also thought to contain terrifying power.

SPECIES_SKIDDO.name: Skiddo
SPECIES_SKIDDO.description: If it has sunshine and water, it doesn't need to eat, because it can generate energy from the leaves on its back. It has a placid disposition.

SPECIES_GOGOAT.name: Gogoat
SPECIES_GOGOAT.description: It can tell how its trainer is feeling by subtle shifts in the grip on its horns. This empathetic sense lets them run as if one being. They inhabit mountainous regions.

SPECIES_PANCHAM.name: Pancham
SPECIES_PANCHAM.description: There's no point to the leaf in its mouth, aside from an effort to look cool. It's mischievous, so it's not well suited to inexperienced Trainers.

SPECIES_PANGORO.name: Pangoro
SPECIES_PANGORO.description: It boasts superb physical strength. Those who wish to become Pangoro's Trainer have no choice but to converse with their fists.

SPECIES_ESPURR.name: Espurr
SPECIES_ESPURR.description: It has enough psychic energy to blast everything within 300 feet of itself. The organ that emits its intense psychic power is sheltered by its ears.

SPECIES_MEOWSTIC_M.name: Meowstic
SPECIES_MEOWSTIC_M.description: The defensive instinct of the males is strong. It's when they're protecting themselves or their partners that they unleash their full power.

SPECIES_MEOWSTIC_F.name: Meowstic
SPECIES_MEOWSTIC_F.description: Females are a bit more selfish and aggressive than males. If they don't get what they want, they will torment you with their psychic abilities.

SPECIES_HONEDGE.name: Honedge
SPECIES_HONEDGE.description: If anyone dares to grab its hilt, it wraps a blue cloth around that person's arm and drains that person's life energy completely.

SPECIES_DOUBLADE.name: Doublade
SPECIES_DOUBLADE.description: When Honedge evolves, it divides into two swords. The complex attack patterns of its two swords are unstoppable, even against those skilled at swordplay.

SPECIES_AEGISLASH_SHIELD.name: Aegislash
SPECIES_AEGISLASH_SHIELD.description: In this defensive stance, Aegislash uses its steel body and a force field of spectral power to reduce the damage of any attack.

SPECIES_AEGISLASH_BLADE.name: Aegislash
SPECIES_AEGISLASH_BLADE.description: Once upon a time, a king with an Aegislash reigned over the land. His Pokémon eventually drained him of life, and his kingdom fell with him.

SPECIES_SPRITZEE.name: Spritzee
SPECIES_SPRITZEE.description: In the past, rather than using perfume, royal ladies carried a Spritzee that would waft a fragrance they liked. Its fragrance changes depending on what it has eaten.

SPECIES_AROMATISSE.name: Aromatisse
SPECIES_AROMATISSE.description: Its scent is so overpowering that, unless a Trainer happens to really enjoy the smell, he or she will have a hard time walking alongside it.

SPECIES_SWIRLIX.name: Swirlix
SPECIES_SWIRLIX.description: Because it eats nothing but sweets, its fur is as sticky sweet as cotton candy. To entangle its opponents in battle, it extrudes sticky white threads.

SPECIES_SLURPUFF.name: Slurpuff
SPECIES_SLURPUFF.description: Slurpuff can distinguish even the faintest of scents. It puts its sensitive sense of smell to use by helping pastry chefs in their work.

SPECIES_INKAY.name: Inkay
SPECIES_INKAY.description: It flashes the light-emitting spots on its body, which drains its opponent's will to fight. It takes the opportunity to scuttle away and hide.

SPECIES_MALAMAR.name: Malamar
SPECIES_MALAMAR.description: It lures prey close with hypnotic motions, then wraps its tentacles around it before finishing it off with digestive fluids. It forces others to do whatever it wants.

SPECIES_BINACLE.name: Binacle
SPECIES_BINACLE.description: They stretch and then contract, yanking their rocks along with them in bold hops. They eat seaweed that washes up on the shoreline.

SPECIES_BARBARACLE.name: Barbaracle
SPECIES_BARBARACLE.description: Barbaracle's legs and hands have minds of their own, and they will move independently. But they usually follow the head's orders.

SPECIES_SKRELP.name: Skrelp
SPECIES_SKRELP.description: Camouflaged as rotten kelp, it hides from foes while storing up power for its evolution. They spray liquid poison on prey that approach unawares.

SPECIES_DRAGALGE.name: Dragalge
SPECIES_DRAGALGE.description: Their poison is strong enough to eat through the hull of a tanker. Tales are told of ships that wander into seas where Dragalge live, never to return.

SPECIES_CLAUNCHER.name: Clauncher
SPECIES_CLAUNCHER.description: Through controlled expulsions of internal gas, it can expel water like a pistol shot. At close distances, it can even shatter large rocks.

SPECIES_CLAWITZER.name: Clawitzer
SPECIES_CLAWITZER.description: By expelling water from the nozzle in the back of its enormous claw, it can move at a speed of 60 knots. They launch cannonballs made of water.

SPECIES_HELIOPTILE.name: Helioptile
SPECIES_HELIOPTILE.description: They make their home in deserts. They can generate their own energy from basking in the sun, so eating food is not a requirement.

SPECIES_HELIOLISK.name: Heliolisk
SPECIES_HELIOLISK.description: A single Heliolisk can generate sufficient electricity to power a skyscraper. It can stimulate its muscles with electricity, boosting the strength in its legs.

SPECIES_TYRUNT.name: Tyrunt
SPECIES_TYRUNT.description: Its immense jaws have enough destructive force that it can chew up a car. If something happens that it doesn't like, it throws a tantrum and runs wild.
