Shoal Cave Low Tide Lower Room
Shoal Cave Low Tide Inner Room
Shoal Cave Low Tide Entrance Room

SPECIES_TYRANTRUM.name: Tyrantrum
SPECIES_TYRANTRUM.description: Thanks to its gargantuan jaws, which could shred thick metal plates as if they were paper, it was invincible in the ancient world it once inhabited.

SPECIES_AMAURA.name: Amaura
SPECIES_AMAURA.description: This ancient Pokémon was restored from part of its body that had been frozen in ice for over 100 million years. It lived in a cold land where there were no predators.

locations.map: Shoal Cave Low Tide Ice Room

SPECIES_AURORUS.name: Aurorus
SPECIES_AURORUS.description: Using the diamond-shaped crystals on its body it can instantly create a wall of ice to block an opponent's attack, or encase them in ice.

SPECIES_HAWLUCHA.name: Hawlucha
SPECIES_HAWLUCHA.description: With its wings, it controls its position in the air. Its proficient fighting skills enable it to keep up with big bruisers like Machamp and Hariyama.

SPECIES_DEDENNE.name: Dedenne
SPECIES_DEDENNE.description: Its whiskers serve as antennas. By sending and receiving electrical waves, it can communicate with others over vast distances.

SPECIES_CARBINK.name: Carbink
SPECIES_CARBINK.description: Born from the high temperatures and pressures deep underground, it defends itself by firing beams from the jewel part of its body.

SPECIES_GOOMY.name: Goomy
SPECIES_GOOMY.description: Its source of protection is its slimy, germ-laden mucous membrane. Anyone who touches it will need some thorough hand-washing.

SPECIES_SLIGGOO.name: Sliggoo
SPECIES_SLIGGOO.description: This Pokémon's mucous can dissolve anything. Toothless, it sprays mucous on its prey. Once they're nicely dissolved, it slurps them up.

SPECIES_GOODRA.name: Goodra
SPECIES_GOODRA.description: It gets picked on because it's meek. But then, whoever teased it gets to feel the full force of its horns and a good swatting from its thick tail.

SPECIES_SLIGGOO_HISUI.name: Sliggoo
SPECIES_SLIGGOO_HISUI.description: A creature given to melancholy. Its metallic shell developed as a result of the mucus on its skin reacting with the iron in Hisui's water.

SPECIES_GOODRA_HISUI.name: Goodra
SPECIES_GOODRA_HISUI.description: It loathes solitude and is extremely clingy--it will fume and run riot if those dearest to it ever leave its side.

SPECIES_KLEFKI.name: Klefki
SPECIES_KLEFKI.description: These key collectors threaten any attackers by fiercely jingling their keys at them. It will sneak into people's homes to steal their keys.

SPECIES_PHANTUMP.name: Phantump
SPECIES_PHANTUMP.description: According to legend, medicine to cure any illness can be made by plucking the green leaves on its head, brewing them, and boiling down the liquid.

SPECIES_TREVENANT.name: Trevenant
SPECIES_TREVENANT.description: Through its roots, it exerts control over other trees. A deadly curse falls upon anyone cutting down trees in forests where Trevenant dwell.

SPECIES_PUMPKABOO_AVERAGE.name: Pumpkaboo
SPECIES_PUMPKABOO_AVERAGE.description: The light that streams out from the holes in the pumpkin can hypnotize and control the people and Pokémon that see it.

SPECIES_PUMPKABOO_SMALL.name: Pumpkaboo
SPECIES_PUMPKABOO_SMALL.description: When taking spirits to the afterlife, small Pumpkaboo prefer the spirits of children to those of adults.

SPECIES_PUMPKABOO_LARGE.name: Pumpkaboo
SPECIES_PUMPKABOO_LARGE.description: When taking spirits to the afterlife, large Pumpkaboo prefer the spirits of adults to those of children.

SPECIES_PUMPKABOO_SUPER.name: Pumpkaboo
SPECIES_PUMPKABOO_SUPER.description: Supersized Pumpkaboo are very partial to the spirits of people who were of similarly superior proportions.

SPECIES_GOURGEIST_AVERAGE.name: Gourgeist
SPECIES_GOURGEIST_AVERAGE.description: Eerie cries emanate from its body in the dead of night. The sounds are said to be the wails of spirits who are suffering in the afterlife.

SPECIES_GOURGEIST_SMALL.name: Gourgeist
SPECIES_GOURGEIST_SMALL.description: A small-sized Pumpkaboo evolves into a small-sized Gourgeist. Its bodily proportions also get passed on to its descendants.

SPECIES_GOURGEIST_LARGE.name: Gourgeist
SPECIES_GOURGEIST_LARGE.description: A large-sized Pumpkaboo evolves into a large-sized Gourgeist. Its bodily proportions also get passed on to its descendants.

SPECIES_GOURGEIST_SUPER.name: Gourgeist
SPECIES_GOURGEIST_SUPER.description: A supersized Pumpkaboo evolves into a supersized Gourgeist. Its bodily proportions also get passed on to its descendants.

SPECIES_BERGMITE.name: Bergmite
SPECIES_BERGMITE.description: It blocks opponents' attacks with the ice that shields its body. It uses cold air to repair any cracks with new ice. They live in herds on snowy mountains.

SPECIES_AVALUGG.name: Avalugg
SPECIES_AVALUGG.description: The way several Bergmite huddle on its back make it look like an aircraft carrier made of ice. Its cumbersome frame crushes anything that stands in its way.

SPECIES_AVALUGG_HISUI.name: Avalugg
SPECIES_AVALUGG_HISUI.description: The armor of ice covering its lower jaw puts steel to shame and can shatter rocks with ease.

SPECIES_NOIBAT.name: Noibat
SPECIES_NOIBAT.description: They live in pitch-black caves. Even a robust wrestler will become dizzy and unable to stand when exposed to its 200,000-hertz ultrasonic waves.

SPECIES_NOIVERN.name: Noivern
SPECIES_NOIVERN.description: They fly around on moonless nights and attack careless prey. The ultrasonic waves it emits from its ears can reduce a large boulder to pebbles.

SPECIES_NOIVERN_MEGA.name: Noivern
SPECIES_NOIVERN_MEGA.description: Its draconic energy ignited with Mega Evolution and is constantly leaking. It uses it to fly at super speed and power sound waves.

SPECIES_YVELTAL.name: Yveltal
SPECIES_YVELTAL.description: When its life comes to an end, its wings and tail spread wide and glow red, and it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon.
